hindi: वार्षिक नियामक रिपोर्ट — अमेरिकी सूचीबद्ध कंपनी का विस्तृत सालाना विवरण
definition: annual report that listed American companies file with securities regulators, covering audited financials, business description and risk factors
example: Legal added four new pages of risk factors to the 10-K, one of which was, essentially, the weather.

hindi: पूर्वनिर्धारित शेयर बिक्री योजना — अंदरूनी व्यक्ति की पहले से तय ट्रेडिंग व्यवस्था
definition: prearranged trading schedule letting company insiders sell shares automatically, providing defense against insider trading accusations
example: His 10b5-1 plan sold shares the week before the profit warning, and the timing still needed a long explanation.

hindi: 996 काम व्यवस्था — सुबह 9 से रात 9, हफ़्ते में 6 दिन
definition: working from nine in the morning until nine at night, Monday through Saturday, a punishing schedule that originated in Chinese technology startups
example: The founder called it 'startup energy'; the team called it 996 with free snacks.

hindi: 996 दिनचर्या — सुबह नौ से रात नौ, हफ़्ते में छह दिन काम
definition: an extreme working schedule of nine in the morning until nine at night, six days every week, born in Chinese tech
example: The founder called it a 996 schedule; the team called it the reason nobody had seen daylight since March.

hindi: पाइरेट मेट्रिक्स — अधिग्रहण, सक्रियण, प्रतिधारण, रेफ़रल, राजस्व का ढांचा
definition: acquisition, activation, retention, referral, revenue; the pirate metrics funnel
example: We adopted AARRR because saying it in planning is the best part.

hindi: त्वरित निहितीकरण — विदाई या अधिग्रहण पर शेयर समय से पहले मिल जाना
definition: unvested equity becoming owned early, typically triggered by termination after an acquisition or negotiated exit
example: Accelerated vesting is why the founders smiled through the acquisition announcement and everyone else didn't.

hindi: त्वरक कार्यक्रम — स्टार्टअप्स को पूँजी, मार्गदर्शन और मंच देने वाला
definition: a fixed-term program that gives startups money, mentorship, and a demo day
example: The accelerator took seven percent and gave us unlimited coffee and deadlines.

hindi: वेतन जितना काम — तनख़्वाह से ज़्यादा ज़िम्मेदारी न उठाने का रवैया
definition: doing only the work your salary actually covers, declining unpaid extra effort beyond the role and title
example: Asked to lead a second team for no raise, he chose to act his wage and forward the job description.

hindi: सक्रिय निवेशक — हिस्सेदारी लेकर कंपनी में बदलाव का दबाव डालने वाला
definition: an investor who buys a significant stake to pressure the board into changes such as cost cuts, spin-offs or sales
example: The activist investor's open letter arrived on Monday; the sudden enthusiasm for share buybacks arrived on Tuesday.

hindi: तात्कालिक माँग — नियमित रिपोर्ट से बाहर का अचानक आया डेटा अनुरोध
definition: an unplanned, one-time request for numbers or analysis that falls outside the regular reports and usually arrives urgently
example: The analytics roadmap is solid, assuming zero ad hoc requests from the leadership team.

hindi: निकटवर्ती क्षेत्र — मौजूदा कारोबार से सटा नया बाज़ार या उत्पाद
definition: a neighbouring market, customer segment or product close enough to the core business to enter using existing strengths
example: The client called the pet-food business an adjacency, since it was adjacent to having spare warehouse space.

hindi: सहबद्ध विपणन — दूसरों को हर बिक्री पर कमीशन देकर उत्पाद बिकवाना
definition: paying outside publishers or creators commission for each sale arriving through their tracked referral links
example: Affiliate marketing is booming, mostly among coupon sites claiming credit for customers already at checkout.

hindi: समानता से समूह बनाना — शोध नोट्स को विषयों में छाँटना
definition: clustering research notes or sticky notes into related groups to find patterns and themes
example: Affinity mapping produced nine clusters, one of which was simply labelled 'misc, but angry'.

hindi: एजेंसी — डिज़ाइन, विज्ञापन जैसी सेवाएँ देने वाली बाहरी फर्म
definition: an external firm hired for services like design, marketing, or recruiting
example: We paid the agency six figures for a logo we redrew internally.

hindi: एजाइल — छोटे चक्रों में लचीले ढंग से काम करने की कार्यप्रणाली
definition: of software delivery done in short iterative cycles with frequent feedback rather than one big plan
example: We're agile now, which mostly means the meetings have new names.

hindi: एआई अभिशासन — संस्था में एआई के उपयोग पर नीतियाँ और निगरानी
definition: the policies, reviews, and accountability that control how an organization uses AI
example: AI governance now has its own committee, calendar, and acronym-filled charter.

hindi: एआई-प्रथम — शुरुआत से ही एआई को केंद्र में रखकर डिज़ाइन
definition: designing products and workflows around AI capabilities from the start, not bolting them on
example: Going AI-first means the app plans your training week before you open it.

hindi: एआई-चालित — मार्केटिंग का ठप्पा कि उत्पाद में एआई है
definition: a marketing label claiming artificial intelligence drives a product, regardless of how much of the product actually relies on it
example: The toaster is now AI-powered, which mostly means the box is more expensive.

hindi: बोलने का समय — मीटिंग में किसे कितना बोलने को मिला
definition: the share of speaking time each person gets during a meeting or discussion
example: He took ninety percent of the airtime and then asked why nobody else contributed.

hindi: हमेशा सौदा पक्का करो — हर बातचीत को बिक्री की ओर मोड़ने का सेल्स मंत्र
definition: the sales mantra that every conversation with a prospect should push steadily toward a signed contract
example: He took always be closing literally and tried to upsell the caterer at the team lunch.

hindi: मुख्य आधार निवेशक — बड़ा चेक जो बाकी निवेशकों को आकर्षित करे
definition: an investor committing a large early check that signals confidence and attracts other investors into the round
example: Once the anchor investor signed, the funds that had passed twice suddenly found room in their calendars.

hindi: विकास-दिशा खाका — नए/पुराने बाज़ार और उत्पाद से विकास के चार रास्ते
definition: a growth-strategy grid comparing existing and novel products against existing and novel markets to choose between penetration, development and diversification
example: The Ansoff matrix put the new venture in the diversification box, also known as the expensive box.

hindi: हिस्सेदारी सुरक्षा शर्त — घटी क़ीमत के दौर में निवेशक का बचाव
definition: a term protecting investors' stakes if the company later raises at a lower price
example: The anti-dilution clause seemed harmless until the down round arrived.

hindi: मूल्यांकन चक्र — सालाना समीक्षा और वेतन-वृद्धि का दौर
definition: in Indian English, the yearly performance review season that decides ratings, salary hikes and promotions
example: Everyone becomes remarkably visible in the month before the appraisal cycle.

hindi: स्वीकृत विक्रेता सूची — जिन आपूर्तिकर्ताओं से खरीद की अनुमति है
definition: the official register of suppliers that procurement has vetted and approved, which teams must purchase from
example: The tool you want is great, but it isn't on the approved vendor list, so it doesn't exist.

hindi: धारणा-चित्रण — किन मान्यताओं पर उत्पाद टिका है, उन्हें जोखिम के हिसाब से छाँटना
definition: a discovery exercise listing the beliefs a product idea depends on, then ranking them by importance and evidence to test first
example: Assumption mapping revealed the whole plan rested on customers reading onboarding emails.

hindi: लिखित दैनिक अपडेट — मीटिंग के बजाय चैट में रोज़ का प्रगति-संदेश
definition: daily standup replaced by written progress updates posted in a chat channel rather than a live meeting
example: The async standup says everyone is on track, written between nine and eleven in four different timezones.

hindi: क्षमता पूरी — अब और काम लेने की गुंजाइश नहीं
definition: saying you have no remaining time or energy to take on additional work right now
example: She said she was at capacity, and her manager heard 'please add a stretch goal'.

hindi: छँटनी के खतरे में — ब्रिटिश उपयोग में संभावित निकासी की औपचारिक सूचना
definition: in British usage, employees formally told their roles may be eliminated, pending consultation
example: Being at risk of redundancy meant three weeks of meetings about whether he'd have meetings.

hindi: इसके साथ संलग्न — भारतीय औपचारिक ईमेल में संलग्नक की सूचना
definition: formal Indian English email phrase announcing an attachment, as in 'please find attached herewith'
example: Please find attached herewith the file, he wrote, attaching nothing.

hindi: लेखापरीक्षा समिति — वित्तीय रिपोर्टिंग और ऑडिटरों की निगरानी करने वाली बोर्ड समिति
definition: the board committee of independent directors that oversees financial reporting, internal controls and the external auditors
example: The audit committee asked why revenue spiked on the last day of every quarter, and finance asked for more time.

hindi: आधिकारिक संदर्भों के बाहर चुपचाप राय जुटाना
definition: to quietly gather opinions on a candidate outside their offered references
example: The official references were great, but someone backchanneled a former teammate.

hindi: प्रस्ताव से पीछे हटना — स्वीकृति के बाद उम्मीदवार का न आना
definition: in Indian English, a candidate withdrawing after accepting an offer, usually for a better competing offer
example: Recruiting now plans for a twenty percent backout rate and offers accordingly.

hindi: सहायक स्लाइड — मुख्य प्रस्तुति के पीछे रखी विस्तृत स्लाइड
definition: a detailed supporting slide kept in the appendix, shown only when someone questions the numbers on a main slide
example: The CFO skipped the main deck and went straight to backup slide sixty-three.

hindi: संदिग्ध ऋण प्रावधान — न वसूल हो सकने वाली राशि के लिए अलग रखा अनुमान
definition: an estimated amount set aside against receivables the company expects never to collect from customers
example: We raised the bad debt reserve after the client's CFO stopped answering emails and changed his LinkedIn to 'open to work'.

hindi: कार्ड से हाज़िरी — दफ़्तर के गेट पर कार्ड स्वाइप कर उपस्थिति दर्ज करना
definition: swipe your access card at the office entrance so the system records your attendance toward the return-to-office policy
example: Remember to badge in before the coffee, or the attendance report thinks you worked from home.

hindi: मूल मॉडल — फ़ाइन-ट्यूनिंग से पहले का कच्चा प्रशिक्षित मॉडल
definition: a pretrained model before fine-tuning or safety training shapes it for a product
example: The base model knows everything about deadlifts and nothing about being polite.

hindi: वृद्धि-हिस्सेदारी खाका — बाज़ार वृद्धि और हिस्सेदारी पर उत्पादों का वर्गीकरण
definition: a growth-share chart sorting business units by market growth and relative market share into stars, cash cows, question marks and dogs
example: On the BCG matrix, his pet project landed firmly among the dogs, so the axes were redrawn.

hindi: व्यवहारिक साक्षात्कार — पिछले अनुभवों से भविष्य का आचरण परखना
definition: an interview asking candidates to describe past situations to predict future workplace behavior
example: The behavioral interview asked for a time he handled conflict, and he described this interview process.

hindi: घंटी वक्र — रेटिंग को तय अनुपात में बाँटने की व्यवस्था
definition: the practice of fitting employee performance ratings to a normal distribution, capping the number who receive high ratings
example: 'You were great, but the bell curve was full,' said the manager, shrugging at statistics.

hindi: मानक — तुलना के लिए उद्योग या प्रतिस्पर्धी का स्तर
definition: an external reference point used to judge whether your numbers are good
example: We beat the industry benchmark once we picked a different industry.

hindi: केंद्रीय रचनात्मक विचार — पूरा अभियान जिस एक सोच पर टिका हो
definition: the single central creative concept that unifies every execution of a campaign across channels and makes the message memorable
example: The agency's big idea was a hashtag, which we were told would carry the entire budget.

hindi: आधा-आधा खोजना — इतिहास बाँटते हुए बिगाड़ने वाला कमिट पकड़ना
definition: to find the commit that broke things by halving the history repeatedly
example: Two hundred commits, eight bisect steps, one guilty one-liner.

hindi: दोष-मंथन — समस्या सुलझाने के बजाय यह तय करना कि ग़लती किसकी थी
definition: a meeting or discussion spent assigning blame for a failure rather than solving the underlying problem
example: The incident review turned into blamestorming by slide three.

hindi: काम-छुट्टी मेल — व्यावसायिक यात्रा के साथ निजी छुट्टी के दिन जोड़ना
definition: adding personal leisure days to a business trip, with the company paying the travel and you paying the extra hotel nights
example: His Lisbon conference was two days; his bleisure extension was nine.

hindi: नीला सागर — बिना प्रतिस्पर्धा वाला नया बाज़ार
definition: an uncontested market space created by offering something novel, where competitors are irrelevant because nobody else serves it yet
example: We found a blue ocean, then learned it was empty because nobody wanted to pay.

hindi: नीला-हरा परिनियोजन — दो जुड़वाँ वातावरणों में झट अदला-बदली
definition: using two identical environments and switching traffic between them for zero-downtime releases
example: Blue-green deploys, so we can panic and switch back instantly.

hindi: निदेशक मंडल प्रस्तुति — मंडल की बैठक के लिए तैयार स्लाइडों का पुलिंदा
definition: the slide presentation management prepares for each board meeting, summarising results, risks and decisions requested from directors
example: The board deck went through eleven versions, and the only slide anyone discussed was the appendix.

hindi: निदेशक मंडल पर्यवेक्षक — बैठक में आने वाला पर बिना वोट वाला निवेशक प्रतिनिधि
definition: an investor representative who attends board meetings and reads board materials but cannot vote on decisions
example: The board observer had no vote and somehow still had the most questions.

hindi: बैठक-पूर्व दस्तावेज़ पुलिंदा — बैठक से पहले निदेशकों को भेजे जाने वाले सारे काग़ज़ात
definition: the bundle of papers, reports and draft resolutions circulated to directors before a board meeting, common in British and Indian English
example: The board pack ran to four hundred pages, so the directors read the first four and the last one.

hindi: निदेशक मंडल में स्थान — निवेश के बदले मिली निदेशक की कुर्सी
definition: a director position on the company board that a lead investor negotiates as part of leading a financing round
example: He took less money from the second fund because it came without another board seat.

hindi: मिली माँग बनाम बिक्री का अनुपात — नए ऑर्डर और भेजे गए बिलों की तुलना
definition: ratio of orders received to revenue billed during a period; readings above parity signal growing future demand
example: Book-to-bill dipped below one, and so did the mood in the sales channel.

hindi: निगरानी सॉफ़्टवेयर — कर्मचारियों के स्क्रीन, कीस्ट्रोक और गतिविधि पर नज़र रखने वाला प्रोग्राम
definition: employee monitoring software that tracks remote workers' screens, keystrokes, applications and activity levels
example: The bossware flagged him as idle during the one hour he spent thinking.

hindi: नीचे से ऊपर अनुमान — हर टीम के अंदाज़ों को जोड़कर बना पूर्वानुमान
definition: a forecast built by adding together detailed estimates from individual teams, accounts or products
example: The bottom-up forecast added up to twice the target, because every team rounded hope upward.

hindi: स्काउट नियम — जिस कोड को छुएँ, उसे पहले से थोड़ा बेहतर हालत में छोड़ें
definition: the principle of leaving any code you touch slightly cleaner than you found it
example: He applied the boy scout rule to a one-line fix and the pull request touched sixty files.

hindi: उपलब्धि-डायरी — अपने कामों का लगातार रखा गया लेखा
definition: a running personal record of achievements and wins, kept so that reviews and promotion cases practically write themselves
example: She opened her brag document in December and found only one line: 'survived Q2.'

hindi: ब्रांड सौदा — प्रचार के बदले क्रिएटर को ब्रांड से भुगतान
definition: paid agreement where a brand compensates a creator to feature or promote its product in their content
example: The brand deal paid for the new camera, which is now featured in every video as a subtle thank-you.

hindi: ब्रांड-स्तंभ — पहचान के मूल गुण जिन पर सब संदेश टिकते हैं
definition: the three to five core attributes or values that define what a brand stands for and that all messaging should support
example: Our brand pillars are innovation, trust and simplicity, which is also everyone else's.

hindi: सौदा-भंग शुल्क — सौदा टूटने पर एक पक्ष द्वारा दूसरे को दिया जाने वाला भुगतान
definition: a payment one party owes the other if an agreed merger collapses for specified reasons
example: The break fee was large enough that walking away needed its own board approval and its own bankers.

hindi: आपातकालीन खाता — संकट में ही इस्तेमाल होने वाला सर्वाधिकार लॉगिन
definition: emergency administrator login kept sealed for outages, used only when normal access fails, then audited
example: The break-glass account password lived in a sealed envelope, and the envelope lived in a drawer nobody could unlock.

hindi: आरक्षित अतिरिक्त कर्मचारी — ज़रूरत पड़ने पर काम संभालने के लिए रखा गया
definition: in Indian English, an extra unbilled engineer kept on a project as backup against attrition, leave or sudden client demand
example: He was the buffer resource right up until the day he became the entire team.

hindi: बिल्ड सिपाही — बारी-बारी से टूटे बिल्ड और असफल परीक्षणों पर नज़र रखने वाला इंजीनियर
definition: the engineer on a rotating duty who watches the shared build, chasing down broken builds and failing tests
example: The build cop reverted your commit before you finished your coffee.

hindi: सबके सामने बनाना — उत्पाद की प्रगति, आँकड़े और गलतियाँ खुलेआम साझा करना
definition: sharing a startup's product progress, revenue numbers and mistakes openly online while building it
example: He decided to build in public, so the whole internet watched the database migration fail live.

hindi: निर्माण जाल — असर की जगह बस फ़ीचर गिनते रहने में फँसी कंपनी
definition: the state of a company measuring progress by features shipped rather than customer value delivered, mistaking output for outcomes
example: The roadmap had thirty features and zero goals, a textbook build trap with a Gantt chart.

hindi: बनाओ-मापो-सीखो — छोटा बनाकर, नापकर, सीखकर अगला कदम तय करने का चक्र
definition: the lean startup feedback loop of shipping a small experiment, measuring customer response and learning before the next iteration
example: We nailed build and skipped straight past measure and learn, as is tradition.

hindi: शीर्ष बैंक समूह — दुनिया के सबसे बड़े निवेश बैंक
definition: the largest global investment banks, which lead the biggest deals and dominate advisory fee rankings
example: The bulge bracket pitch had nine bankers in the room and one who knew the client's name.

hindi: भार दर — वेतन पर लगने वाला अतिरिक्त ऊपरी खर्च प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage added to base salary to cover benefits, payroll taxes and overhead in a fully loaded cost
example: Finance applied a burden rate of forty percent, and suddenly the contractor looked cheap.

hindi: बजट बनाम वास्तविक — तय बजट और असल खर्च की तुलना रिपोर्ट
definition: budget versus actuals; the recurring report comparing the approved budget against actual spending and revenue
example: The monthly BvA showed travel under budget, mostly because nobody was allowed to travel.

hindi: पूंजीकृत करना — खर्च को संपत्ति मानकर कई सालों में फैलाना
definition: to record a cost as an asset spread over future years instead of an expense this year
example: If we capitalize the engineering work, this year's profit looks better and nobody writes different code.

hindi: हथियार डालना — निराश निवेशकों की सामूहिक घबराहट भरी बिकवाली
definition: the final panicked selling when discouraged investors give up, often marking a price bottom
example: When the last holdout on the team finally agreed to rewrite it, we called it capitulation and ordered pizza.

hindi: करियर रोकने वाला क़दम — ऐसी चाल जो तरक्की बिगाड़ दे
definition: an action, often embarrassing or political, likely to damage someone's reputation and promotion prospects
example: Correcting the CEO's arithmetic during the all-hands was brave and a career-limiting move.

hindi: अंधानुकरण — बिना समझे रस्में दोहराना कि शायद काम करें
definition: copying practices ritually without understanding why they worked elsewhere
example: We adopted their whole setup cargo-cult style, microservices and all.

hindi: आगे ले जाया गया बजट — बचा बजट अगले साल में जोड़ने की अनुमति
definition: unspent budget formally allowed to roll into the next fiscal year rather than returned
example: Finance approved the carryforward, which is the rarest phrase in any budget meeting.

hindi: आकस्मिक अवकाश — छोटे निजी कामों के लिए मिलने वाली छुट्टी
definition: an Indian English category of short, unplanned leave days allowed for personal errands, separate from sick leave
example: He used his last casual leave on the one Friday nothing was scheduled.

hindi: गिरता चाकू पकड़ना — तेज़ी से गिरते भाव में जल्दबाज़ी से खरीदना
definition: buying into a sharply falling price too early, hoping to time the bottom, and taking losses
example: He wanted to acquire the struggling competitor now; the board said no thanks to catching a falling knife.

hindi: अनिवार्य परिवर्तनीय वरीयता शेयर — भारतीय स्टार्टअप निवेश का मानक साधन
definition: compulsorily convertible preference shares; the standard instrument for Indian venture rounds, preferred shares that must eventually convert into equity shares
example: The foreign fund insisted on CCPS, the founders nodded, and the chartered accountant quietly doubled his estimate.

hindi: नराश्व कंपनी — सौ मिलियन डॉलर सालाना आवर्ती आय पार करने वाली सॉफ़्टवेयर कंपनी
definition: a software startup that has crossed one hundred million dollars in annual recurring revenue, rarer than valuation milestones
example: Unicorn is a valuation; centaur is revenue, which is why the CFO only celebrates one of them.

hindi: उत्पाद का सीईओ — प्रोडक्ट मैनेजर की ज़िम्मेदारी (बिना अधिकार) का वर्णन
definition: a popular description of the product manager as owning a product's success, usually without authority over the people building it
example: I'm the CEO of the product, meaning I own the outcome and approve nothing.

hindi: चुनौतीपूर्ण बिक्री — ग्राहक की सोच को चुनौती देकर नई दृष्टि बेचना
definition: selling approach where reps teach customers fresh insight, tailor the message and push back on assumptions
example: She ran the Challenger sale so hard the customer challenged her straight out of the building.

hindi: चलता है — कम गुणवत्ता को भी स्वीकार कर लेने का रवैया
definition: an Indian English borrowing describing a casual attitude of accepting mediocre quality or shortcuts as good enough
example: The chalta hai build shipped Friday; the Monday hotfix did not share its attitude.

hindi: बदलाव थकान — लगातार पुनर्गठन और नई पहलों से कर्मचारियों की थकावट
definition: employee exhaustion and cynicism caused by relentless reorganizations, new initiatives and shifting priorities
example: Change fatigue is when the fourth transformation program gets a slower eye-roll than the third.

hindi: परिवर्तन प्रबंधन — संगठन में बदलाव को सुनियोजित ढंग से अपनाने की प्रक्रिया
definition: structured practice of preparing, supporting and communicating with people so an organisational change actually sticks
example: The change management plan was an email titled 'exciting news' sent at 6 pm Friday.

hindi: नियंत्रण परिवर्तन — अधिग्रहण या स्वामित्व बदलने पर लागू होने वाली शर्तें
definition: contract terms triggered when a company is acquired or its ownership shifts, often allowing termination or accelerating vesting
example: The change of control clause meant the biggest customer could walk the day the acquisition closed.

hindi: चुनिंदा उठाना — किसी शाखा से एक ख़ास कमिट ही लेना
definition: to copy one specific commit onto another branch, leaving the rest behind
example: Just cherry-pick the fix, not the seventeen commits around it.

hindi: बाद में लौटना — बिना फ़ैसला किए चर्चा टालने का विनम्र तरीक़ा
definition: to return to a topic later; often a polite way to end a discussion without deciding
example: Let's circle back next week — and it was never spoken of again.

hindi: परिचालित प्रस्ताव — बिना बैठक के काग़ज़ घुमाकर लिया गया बोर्ड निर्णय
definition: a board decision passed by circulating a written resolution for signatures instead of holding a meeting, common in Indian English
example: The directors approved it by circular resolution, which meant the company secretary chased signatures across four timezones.

hindi: समापन योजना — सौदा पूरा करने के लिए बचे कदमों की सूची
definition: seller's written sequence of remaining approvals, meetings and paperwork needed before signature
example: His close plan read 'step one: customer signs', which the deal review found insufficiently detailed.

hindi: सह-बिक्री अधिकार — संस्थापक शेयर बेचे तो निवेशक भी अपना हिस्सा बेच सकें
definition: an investor right to sell a proportional slice of their shares whenever founders sell shares to a third party
example: The founder's quiet secondary sale was less quiet once three funds invoked their co-sale right.

hindi: कॉफ़ी लॉटरी — रिमोट सहकर्मियों को अनौपचारिक बातचीत के लिए बेतरतीब जोड़ियों में मिलाना
definition: pairing remote colleagues randomly each week for informal social video chats across teams
example: Coffee roulette matched me with the CFO, and we discussed the weather for thirty very careful minutes.

hindi: शीत आरंभ — नए उपयोगकर्ता का डेटा न होने से सिफ़ारिशों की मुश्किल
definition: the struggle to serve good predictions for brand-new users or items with no data
example: Day-one users get the cold start special: three generic workouts and a questionnaire.

hindi: बिक्री सामग्री — ब्रोशर, डेक और परिचय दस्तावेज़
definition: the decks, one-pagers, and brochures sales leaves behind with prospects
example: The rep asked for updated collateral, meaning the deck from before the rebrand.

hindi: आदेश-नियंत्रण शैली — ऊपर से निर्देश, नीचे से पालन वाला कठोर प्रबंधन
definition: a top-down management style where decisions come from senior leaders and teams execute orders with little autonomy
example: We moved away from command and control, announced the CEO, effective as soon as he approved it.

hindi: बिक्री पर कमीशन — सौदे के अनुपात में कमाई
definition: the percentage of a deal's value paid to the salesperson who closed it
example: Nothing focuses the mind like commission on a seven-figure deal.

hindi: कमीशन की बेचैनी — सेल्सकर्मी की उतावली जिसे ग्राहक तुरंत भाँप लेता है
definition: the visible desperation of a salesperson chasing commission, which prospects sense and which scares deals away
example: He followed up three times before lunch, and the buyer could smell the commission breath through email.

hindi: प्रतिबद्ध ख़र्च — अनुबंध के तहत विक्रेता पर न्यूनतम राशि ख़र्च करने का वादा
definition: a contractual promise to spend a minimum amount with a vendor over a term, usually exchanged for discounts
example: We have committed spend left in December, which is how the team got new laptops and a mysterious service.

hindi: प्रतिपूरक अवकाश — छुट्टी वाले दिन काम करने के बदले मिली छुट्टी
definition: compensatory off; Indian English term for leave granted in exchange for working weekends or public holidays
example: He earned a comp off for the Sunday release and spent it fixing the Sunday release.

hindi: तुलनात्मक वेतन अनुपात — वेतन को बैंड के मध्य बिंदु से भाग
definition: an employee's salary divided by the midpoint of their salary range, showing whether they are paid below or above market
example: HR says her compa-ratio is 0.82, which is a polite decimal for underpaid.

hindi: निर्णायक घटना — जो ख़रीद को टालने न दे
definition: a deadline or trigger forcing the customer to buy now rather than someday
example: No compelling event, no deal — 'someday' is not a close date.

hindi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी का ग्राहक छीनना — दूसरे विक्रेता के मौजूदा ग्राहक को अपनी ओर करना
definition: a deal secured by displacing a competitor already installed at the customer, usually rewarded with extra commission
example: The competitive takeout earned him a bonus, a trophy and a very cold email from his former colleague.

hindi: स्थायीकरण — परिवीक्षा के बाद नौकरी पक्की होना
definition: an Indian English term for an employee's formal move from probation to permanent status after review
example: Her confirmation letter arrived eight months after her confirmation date.

hindi: विश्लेषकों का औसत अनुमान — बाज़ार की साझा उम्मीद
definition: average analyst forecast for company revenue or earnings, against which quarterly results are judged a beat or miss
example: Earnings rose forty percent, but consensus wanted forty-two, so the stock fell.

hindi: रचनात्मक बर्ख़ास्तगी — हालात इतने बिगाड़ना कि कर्मचारी ख़ुद इस्तीफ़ा दे
definition: legal term for an employer making conditions so intolerable that resigning becomes effectively forced
example: Moving his desk into the stairwell was, his lawyer argued, constructive dismissal.

hindi: सामग्री डिज़ाइन — उपयोगकर्ता की ज़रूरत से शब्द और जानकारी गढ़ना
definition: designing the words, structure and information in a product around user needs, not merely writing copy
example: Content design cut the help page from nine hundred words to forty, and the tickets dropped.

hindi: सामग्री निगरानी — हानिकारक या अनुचित सामग्री को छानकर रोकना
definition: filtering harmful or inappropriate content from what users and models produce
example: Content moderation caught the gym-selfie captions before they reached the community feed.

hindi: संदर्भ अभियांत्रिकी — मॉडल को दिखने वाली हर जानकारी की सोची-समझी व्यवस्था
definition: designing everything a model sees — instructions, documents, history — not just the prompt
example: Prompt engineering is out; context engineering is the same job with a better title.

hindi: शब्द-संग्रह दस्तावेज़ — स्क्रीन के सारे लिखित पाठ एक जगह
definition: a document collecting every piece of interface text for a feature, reviewed separately from the visuals
example: Legal edited the copy deck, which nobody told the designers, who shipped the old words.

hindi: मुख्य अद्यतन — सर्च इंजन की रैंकिंग प्रणाली में बड़ा बदलाव
definition: major search engine change to its ranking system that reshuffles which websites appear for search results
example: After the core update, the SEO team spent a week refreshing dashboards and their resumes.

hindi: लागत बँटवारा — साझा खर्च को विभागों में बाँटना
definition: distributing shared overhead costs across departments using a formula, whether or not they consumed them
example: Cost allocation put a slice of the CEO's jet on the support team's budget.

hindi: खर्च पर अनुशासन — ख़र्च को सख़्ती से काबू में रखना
definition: management tightly controlling spending and hiring to protect margins, praised by investors when revenue growth slows
example: Cost discipline arrived the same week as the new corporate jet.

hindi: क्रांतिक पथ — कार्यों की वह शृंखला जो कुल अवधि तय करती है
definition: the chain of dependent tasks that determines the project's minimum duration
example: Design review is on the critical path, so everyone suddenly cares.

hindi: ग्राहक-संबंध प्रबंधन सॉफ़्टवेयर — संपर्कों और सौदों का रिकॉर्ड
definition: customer relationship management software — the database of every contact, deal, and broken promise
example: If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen; it's not in the CRM.

hindi: संस्कृति-वाहक — जो कंपनी के मूल्यों को अपने व्यवहार से जीता और फैलाता है
definition: a trusted employee who embodies the company's values and actively passes them on to newer colleagues
example: Every new hire is paired with a culture carrier, mostly so someone explains why the kitchen has a gong.

hindi: संस्कृति डेक — कंपनी के मूल्यों और काम के तरीक़ों को बताने वाली प्रस्तुति
definition: a slide presentation describing a company's values, working norms and expectations, shared with candidates and staff
example: Slide nine of the culture deck said 'no politics'; slide ten was about who reports to whom.

hindi: कंपनी की संस्कृति से मेल — कई बार 'हम जैसे लोग' का पर्दा
definition: how well a candidate matches company culture; sometimes code for 'similar to us'
example: Rejected for culture fit, which no one could define when asked.

hindi: सुधार अवधि — उल्लंघन ठीक करने के लिए दी गई मोहलत
definition: the window after written notice of a breach during which the breaching party may remedy it before termination rights kick in
example: We had a thirty-day cure period and used twenty-nine of them arguing about what counted as cured.

hindi: ग्राहक यात्रा — पहली जानकारी से नवीनीकरण तक ग्राहक के सभी चरण
definition: complete sequence of stages and interactions a customer experiences with a company, from first awareness through purchase, onboarding, support and renewal
example: The customer journey map had twelve stages and every single one ended at the billing page.

hindi: चक्रीय गिनती — पूरे गोदाम की जगह हिस्सों में नियमित माल-गिनती
definition: counting a rotating subset of warehouse inventory regularly instead of shutting down for one annual full stocktake
example: The cycle count found three hundred extra units, which somehow made accounting angrier.

hindi: डेटा नियंत्रक — जो तय करे कि निजी डेटा क्यों और कैसे उपयोग होगा
definition: the organization that decides why and how personal data is processed and carries primary legal responsibility under privacy laws
example: We're the data controller for employee records and merely the processor for customer uploads, a distinction nobody enjoyed learning.

hindi: डेटा शब्दकोश — हर फ़ील्ड और मेट्रिक का अर्थ बताने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: a reference document defining every field, column and metric in a dataset so everyone reads the numbers the same way
example: According to the data dictionary, active user means three different things depending on the team.

hindi: डेटा का ढेर — बिना विश्लेषण या सफ़ाई के सौंपा गया कच्चा डेटा
definition: a large raw export of records handed over without cleaning, summary or explanation, usually as an enormous spreadsheet
example: He asked for insight and received a data dump with eleven tabs and no headers.

hindi: डेटा सफ़ाईकर्मी — ज़्यादातर समय डेटा साफ़ करने में लगाने वाला विश्लेषक
definition: self-deprecating description of an analyst whose working hours mostly go into cleaning and fixing messy data rather than analysis
example: They hired a machine learning expert and turned her into the team's full-time data janitor.

hindi: डेटा विषाक्तता — प्रशिक्षण डेटा बिगाड़कर मॉडल को ग़लत सिखाना
definition: corrupting training data so a model learns wrong or malicious behavior
example: Someone bulk-logged fake workouts; call it data poisoning or call it cheating.

hindi: डेटा को साधना — बिखरे कच्चे डेटा को विश्लेषण लायक़ रूप में ढालना
definition: the messy manual work of cleaning, reshaping and combining raw data from different sources into a format ready for analysis
example: Her job title says data scientist; her calendar says eighty percent data wrangling.

hindi: डेटा बहुत, समझ कम — ढेरों आँकड़े पर उनसे कोई काम की बात नहीं
definition: describes an organisation that collects enormous amounts of data but draws few useful conclusions or decisions from it
example: Two hundred dashboards and no answers: textbook data-rich, insight-poor.

hindi: आँकड़ों पर अंतिम ताला — विश्लेषण से पहले ट्रायल के परिणाम स्थायी रूप से जमा करना
definition: the point when clinical trial data is finalized and frozen so statisticians can unblind and analyse results
example: Nobody takes leave the week of database lock, and nobody sleeps the week after.

hindi: पहले दिन की परिकल्पना — शुरू में ही अनुमानित उत्तर, जिसे फिर जाँचा जाए
definition: a proposed answer written at the very start of a project, which the team then spends weeks testing with analysis
example: Our day-one hypothesis survived twelve weeks of analysis, mostly because nobody wanted to redo the deck.

hindi: रियायती नकदी प्रवाह — भविष्य की कमाई को आज के मूल्य में बदलकर मूल्यांकन
definition: discounted cash flow; valuing a business by projecting future cash flows and discounting them back to present value
example: Change the terminal growth rate by half a point and the DCF will tell you anything you like.

hindi: बेअसर क्लिक — ऐसी जगह क्लिक जहाँ कुछ नहीं होता
definition: a click on something that looks interactive but triggers nothing, tracked as a usability failure signal
example: The dead clicks clustered on a decorative arrow that the brand team refused to remove.

hindi: सौदा अनुमोदन दल — गैर-मानक कीमत और शर्तें मंज़ूर करने वाली टीम
definition: internal team approving non-standard pricing, discounts and contract terms before a deal is signed
example: The deal desk rejected the forty-percent discount, so the rep called it a 'strategic partnership' and resubmitted.

hindi: सौदा पंजीकरण — भागीदार द्वारा अपना सौदा पहले दर्ज कराना
definition: partner claiming a specific opportunity in advance, protecting their discount and preventing channel competition
example: The reseller filed deal registration for every company in Pune, just to be safe.

hindi: सौदा समीक्षा — किसी एक बड़े सौदे की गहन जाँच
definition: focused inspection of a single large deal, testing its qualification, champion, risks and close plan
example: The deal review lasted ninety minutes and ended with everyone agreeing the customer should probably be asked.

hindi: स्वतः मृत — बिना नए निवेश के मुनाफ़े तक न पहुँच पाना
definition: unable to reach profitability with current cash, dependent on future fundraising
example: Default dead isn't a mood, the CEO said, it's a spreadsheet.

hindi: निर्भरता नरक — आपस में टकराते पैकेज संस्करणों का चक्रव्यूह
definition: the maze of conflicting package versions that refuses every resolution
example: Upgraded one library, entered dependency hell, cancelled the afternoon.

hindi: समिति का डिज़ाइन — सबकी राय मिलाकर बना बेस्वाद नतीजा
definition: a design shaped by too many stakeholders' opinions until it pleases nobody and commits to nothing
example: Design by committee gave the homepage four hero banners and one very tired designer.

hindi: डिज़ाइन दस्तावेज़ — निर्माण से पहले तकनीकी योजना और विकल्पों का लिखित ब्योरा
definition: a written document describing the technical design, alternatives and tradeoffs of a system before engineers build it
example: The design doc was approved on Tuesday and quietly contradicted by the code on Wednesday.

hindi: दिखावटी डिज़ाइन प्रक्रिया — असर के बिना रस्मी वर्कशॉप
definition: design rituals like workshops and sticky notes performed for show while decisions were already made elsewhere
example: The design theater ran all day; the roadmap had been locked the week before.

hindi: मेज़ आरक्षण — दफ़्तर आने से पहले ऐप में बैठने की जगह पक्की करना
definition: reserving a shared office desk ahead through a workplace booking system before coming into the office
example: Desk booking opened at nine and every window seat was gone by 9:02.

hindi: कौशल-क्षरण — मशीन पर निर्भरता से अपनी क्षमता घटना
definition: the gradual loss of professional skills when workers hand routine thinking to automation and stop practising it
example: Nobody on the team can write a regex without the assistant anymore; deskilling arrived quietly.

hindi: भंडार घटाना — ग्राहकों का पुराना माल ख़त्म करने तक नया ऑर्डर रोकना
definition: customers and distributors running down excess inventory instead of placing fresh orders, temporarily depressing supplier sales
example: It's destocking, not lost demand, said management for the third straight quarter.

hindi: विकास-संचालन एकीकरण — सॉफ़्टवेयर बनाने और चलाने वाली टीमों को एक साथ जोड़ने वाली कार्य-संस्कृति
definition: the practice of merging software development and operations work, so the engineers who build a service also deploy and operate it
example: We adopted DevOps, which mostly meant the developers now get the phone calls.

hindi: ऑनलाइन दिखावा — व्यस्त दिखने के लिए हमेशा चैट पर सक्रिय और तुरंत जवाब देना
definition: staying visibly online and replying instantly to chat messages to look productive while working remotely
example: His digital presenteeism was flawless: green all day, replies in seconds, output unclear.

hindi: आय घटाने वाला — सौदे से प्रति शेयर कमाई घटना
definition: describing an acquisition, share issue or investment expected to reduce earnings per share, at least initially
example: The deal is dilutive near term, which is why the slide started in 2029.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष सूचीकरण — नए शेयर जारी किए बिना सीधे शेयर बाज़ार में सूचीबद्ध होना
definition: going public by listing existing shares straight onto an exchange, skipping underwriters and without raising fresh capital
example: We chose a direct listing to save on bank fees and spent the savings on the launch-day party.

hindi: असहमत रहो पर साथ दो — बहस के बाद फ़ैसले को पूरी ताक़त से निभाना
definition: to voice objections to a decision openly, then fully support executing it once the decision has been made
example: I disagreed and committed, and I have the calendar invites to prove both.

hindi: वितरण सूची — समूह को एक साथ ईमेल भेजने का पता
definition: slang for a distribution list, the email address that reaches every member of a group
example: Add me to the distro, he said, and immediately started filtering it to trash.

hindi: लाभांश पुनर्पूंजीकरण — नया कर्ज़ लेकर मालिकों को विशेष लाभांश देना
definition: a private equity move where a company borrows new debt to pay owners a special dividend
example: The dividend recap returned the fund's money early and left the company a charming new interest bill.

hindi: दोहरा हीरा मॉडल — फैलाओ-सिकोड़ो दो बार की डिज़ाइन प्रक्रिया
definition: a design model: diverge and converge on the problem, then the solution
example: We did the double diamond, though ours looked more like one confused circle.

hindi: प्रश्न — किसी बात पर स्पष्टीकरण की ज़रूरत
definition: an Indian English usage meaning a question or point needing clarification, rather than disbelief
example: I have one small doubt, he said, opening a forty-minute redesign of the architecture.

hindi: शिखर से गिरावट — किसी निवेश का ऊँचाई से निचले बिंदु तक का नुकसान
definition: the decline in value from a portfolio's peak to its lowest point before recovering
example: The fund's drawdown was described in the investor letter as a character-building period.

hindi: कारक-आधारित योजना — बिक्री, ग्राहक जैसे मूल कारकों से वित्तीय योजना बनाना
definition: planning where financial forecasts are calculated from operational drivers such as customers, prices and headcount
example: Driver-based planning is elegant until someone asks what drives the drivers.

hindi: चैट में डाल दो — मीटिंग की चैट में लिंक या जानकारी भेजना
definition: asking someone to post a link, document or detail into the video call's text chat
example: Drop it in the chat, said everyone, and the chat vanished when the call ended.

hindi: सूखी पदोन्नति — बिना वेतन बढ़े सिर्फ़ पद का बदलना
definition: a promotion bringing a grander title and more responsibility but without any salary increase
example: The dry promotion came with a longer email signature and a longer workday.

hindi: डेटा विषय पहुँच अनुरोध — व्यक्ति द्वारा अपनी सारी जानकारी माँगना
definition: data subject access request; a person's legal demand to receive copies of all personal data a company holds about them
example: The ex-employee's DSAR returned every Slack message mentioning him, including the ones about his DSAR.

hindi: सबसे कठिन काम पहले — दिन की शुरुआत सबसे अप्रिय काम से करना
definition: productivity habit of tackling the hardest, most dreaded task first thing each morning before anything else
example: I meant to eat the frog today, but the frog had a meeting invite attached.

hindi: आपात बदलाव — सामान्य मंज़ूरी छोड़कर तुरंत किया गया सिस्टम सुधार
definition: urgent production system change that skips normal approval, justified afterwards through paperwork and review
example: It became an emergency change the moment someone realised the board would not meet until Tuesday.

hindi: भावनात्मक श्रम — काम के लिए भावनाओं को संभालने और दबाने का अनदेखा परिश्रम
definition: the unpaid effort of managing feelings at work, staying cheerful, calming colleagues or absorbing difficult customers
example: Handling the client's tantrum was emotional labor; logging it in the timesheet was fiction.

hindi: साम्राज्य-निर्माण — अपनी टीम, हेडकाउंट और बजट बढ़ाकर दफ़्तरी सत्ता जमाना
definition: growing your own headcount, budget and territory to accumulate organisational power rather than serve business needs
example: His empire building reached the point where his team had its own reorg.

hindi: नियुक्ति पत्र — परियोजना का दायरा, शुल्क और शर्तें तय करने वाला पत्र
definition: formal letter defining a consulting project's scope, fees, timing and terms before client work starts
example: The engagement letter said six weeks; the client's calendar said something more ambitious.

hindi: परियोजना प्रबंधक — ग्राहक परियोजना और टीम का रोज़ का संचालन करने वाला
definition: consultant who runs a client project daily, managing the team, workplan and client relationship
example: The engagement manager promised the client Friday and promised the team it was fine.

hindi: बड़ी कंपनियों का वर्ग — हज़ारों कर्मचारियों वाले ग्राहक
definition: the largest customer segment, with big budgets, long sales cycles, and longer security reviews
example: Enterprise deals: nine months of meetings, one signature, champagne.

hindi: हिस्सेदार साझेदार — फ़र्म के मुनाफ़े में हिस्सा पाने वाला मालिक-साझेदार
definition: partner who owns part of a professional services firm and shares directly in its profits
example: Once he became an equity partner, the coffee budget suddenly became a personal matter.

hindi: त्रुटि बजट — कितनी विफलता स्वीकार्य है, उसकी तय सीमा
definition: the agreed amount of failure a service may spend before feature work stops
example: We spent the quarter's error budget in one enthusiastic afternoon.

hindi: शिकायत-वृद्धि तालिका — समस्या न सुलझने पर किस-किस स्तर पर किसे संपर्क करें, इसकी सूची
definition: common in Indian English: a table naming whom to contact, level by level, when a vendor issue stays unresolved
example: We reached level three of the escalation matrix and found it was the same person's personal mobile.

hindi: बाहर पहुँचाया गया — निकाले जाने के बाद सुरक्षा के साथ दफ़्तर से विदा
definition: walked from the building by security or a manager immediately after termination, access already revoked
example: She was escorted out holding a cardboard box and the office plant she'd kept alive for years.

hindi: विकल्प पुनर्खरीद — कंपनी द्वारा कर्मचारियों के निहित विकल्प नकद में वापस खरीदना
definition: in Indian English, a company repurchasing vested employee stock options for cash, giving staff early liquidity before any exit
example: The ESOP buyback paid for a car, which the finance team called 'the retention strategy working'.

hindi: सदाबहार खंड — अनुबंध को लगातार अपने आप नवीनीकृत रखने की शर्त
definition: a contract provision renewing the agreement indefinitely, period after period, until either party sends formal cancellation notice
example: The evergreen clause kept that vendor in our budget longer than two CFOs.

hindi: पेटेंट को हरा रखना — छोटे बदलावों से दवा का एकाधिकार आगे खींचना
definition: extending patent protection on an existing drug through minor reformulations, dosages or delivery devices before generic competition arrives
example: The extended-release tablet was sold as innovation and budgeted as evergreening.

hindi: विशेषज्ञ संपर्क-जाल — शुल्क पर उद्योग जानकारों से बातचीत करवाने वाली सेवा
definition: paid service connecting consultants and investors with industry specialists for short research calls
example: The expert network found a former plant manager, who charged more per hour than the partner.

hindi: हाज़िरी का प्रदर्शन — मैनेजर और नेतृत्व के सामने दफ़्तर में दिखाई देने का समय
definition: hours spent visibly present in front of managers and leadership, often rewarded at promotion time more than actual output
example: He schedules his face time carefully: arrives after the director, leaves after the director.

hindi: विकल्प पर स्विच — मुख्य सिस्टम रुकने पर काम अपने-आप बैकअप सिस्टम पर चले जाना
definition: the switch of live traffic from a failing primary system to a standby backup, either automatically or by hand
example: The failover worked in four seconds; noticing it needed four hours.

hindi: पहले संपर्क में समाधान — दोबारा संपर्क के बिना समस्या सुलझ जाना
definition: first contact resolution; the share of customer problems resolved completely during the first interaction without follow-up contacts
example: FCR looks wonderful when the customer gives up after the first contact.

hindi: फ़ीचर शाखा — किसी एक फ़ीचर पर काम के लिए मुख्य शाखा से अलग बनाई गई शाखा
definition: a separate branch created from the main branch to develop one feature before merging it back
example: Her feature branch is called 'quick-fix' and is eleven weeks old.

hindi: विशेषताओं की तुलना — प्रतिद्वंद्वियों से आमने-सामने तालिका
definition: a chart comparing your product's features against competitors', authored by the winner
example: In our feature comparison we have all the checkmarks; funny how that works.

hindi: फ़ीचर कारख़ाना — परिणाम देखे बिना बस फ़ीचर बनाते जाने वाली टीम
definition: a product organization that measures success by features shipped rather than customer outcomes, shipping output without checking impact
example: We're a feature factory: forty launches this year and nobody can say which one mattered.

hindi: सुविधा क़ब्रिस्तान — बंद की जा चुकी सुविधाओं की सामूहिक स्मृति
definition: the collective memory of features that shipped and were quietly removed
example: Add it to the feature graveyard, next to the social feed of 2021.

hindi: आदेश-पालक टीम — ऊपर से तय फ़ीचर बस बनाकर देने वाली टीम
definition: a product team handed a roadmap of features to build, measured on delivery rather than on solving customer problems
example: As a feature team, our discovery process is reading the ticket the director wrote.

hindi: महसूस-महसूस किया-पाया — आपत्ति को सहानुभूति और दूसरों के अनुभव से सँभालना
definition: an objection handling script: acknowledge how the buyer feels, note others felt similarly, explain what those customers found
example: He used feel-felt-found so often that customers started finishing the sentence for him.

hindi: न्यासीय कर्तव्य — दूसरों के धन और हित को अपने हित से ऊपर रखने का कानूनी दायित्व
definition: the legal obligation of directors and officers to act in the company's and shareholders' best interests, above their own
example: Legal reminded the board of its fiduciary duty, which is why the CEO's cousin's catering bid was politely declined.

hindi: क्षेत्रीय बिक्री — ग्राहकों से आमने-सामने मिलकर बिक्री
definition: selling through in-person customer visits and meetings, usually reserved for large enterprise accounts
example: Field sales insists the deal needed a dinner in Singapore, and the expense report agrees.

hindi: पूर्ति दर — तुरंत भंडार से पूरे हुए ऑर्डरों का प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage of customer orders or units shipped immediately from available stock without backorders or stockouts
example: Our fill rate looks heroic because we quietly delisted everything we kept running out of.

hindi: वित्तीय खरीदार — मुनाफ़े हेतु कंपनी खरीदने वाला निवेश फ़र्म
definition: a private equity or investment firm acquiring a business for financial returns rather than product combination
example: The financial buyer loved our margins and wanted to discuss improving them, starting with headcount.

hindi: लाने, संभालने, करने वाले — फ़र्म में काम के तीन स्तर
definition: the three professional services firm roles: winning clients, managing client relationships, and doing the actual work
example: Three years in, he could finally tell he was a grinder who minded the finders.

hindi: आपात बिक्री — मजबूरी में सस्ते दाम पर कंपनी बेचना
definition: selling a company or its assets fast and cheap, usually under distress
example: The 'strategic acquisition' was a fire sale with better fonts.

hindi: पहला मरीज़ शामिल — ट्रायल में पहले प्रतिभागी का नामांकन
definition: the milestone when the first participant enrolls or receives treatment in a clinical trial, starting the study clock
example: First patient in was celebrated with cake, which was optimistic given enrolment for the other four hundred.

hindi: पहला क्लिक परीक्षण — उपयोगकर्ता सबसे पहले कहाँ क्लिक करता है
definition: a usability test measuring where users click first when attempting a task, predicting overall task success
example: The first-click test showed everyone heading for the logo, which, regrettably, did nothing.

hindi: आकार-दूरी नियम — बड़ा और पास लक्ष्य जल्दी छुआ जाता है
definition: the principle that bigger, closer targets are faster to click, cited when sizing buttons
example: Citing Fitts's law, she made the 'Delete account' button smaller and further away.

hindi: पाँच सेकंड परीक्षण — पहली झलक में क्या याद रहा
definition: showing users a screen for five seconds, then asking what they remember, to test first impressions
example: In the five-second test, most people remembered the stock photo and nobody remembered the product.

hindi: निश्चित मूल्य अनुबंध — पूरे प्रोजेक्ट की पहले से तय कीमत
definition: services contract where the vendor delivers agreed scope for a fixed price, absorbing any effort overrun at its own cost
example: Scope creep on a fixed bid is how a profitable deal becomes a case study.

hindi: न्यूनतम कीमत — जिससे नीचे बिना विशेष मंज़ूरी के बेचना मना है
definition: the lowest approved price a salesperson may quote before the discount must be escalated for special approval
example: We never go below the floor price, except at quarter end, when the floor becomes a suggestion.

hindi: उतार-चढ़ाव विश्लेषण — पिछली अवधि की तुलना में बड़े बदलावों की व्याख्या
definition: explaining significant changes in account balances between periods, usually any movement above a defined threshold
example: The flux analysis asked why travel doubled; the answer was one offsite in Goa.

hindi: उचित बाज़ार मूल्य — किसी शेयर का आधिकारिक आँका गया मूल्य
definition: fair market value; the official price assigned to shares, driving option strike prices and employee taxation
example: The FMV of our common stock is a number both sacred and entirely theoretical.

hindi: दैवीय-घटना खंड — बाढ़, युद्ध जैसी अनहोनी पर दायित्व से छूट
definition: a clause excusing obligations during extraordinary events like disasters
example: The vendor cited force majeure; the outage cited their intern.

hindi: पूर्वानुमान बैठक — इस तिमाही कितना राजस्व आएगा, इसका वादा
definition: weekly sales meeting where managers state expected quarter revenue, deal by deal, to leadership
example: On the forecast call, the region moved its number up, down, and back up within four minutes.

hindi: संस्थापक इंजीनियर — शुरुआती दौर में जुड़ा, कम वेतन और ज़्यादा इक्विटी वाला पहला इंजीनियर
definition: one of the first engineers hired at an early startup, typically trading salary for larger equity and broad ownership
example: As founding engineer she owned the backend, the frontend, the office Wi-Fi and the coffee machine.

hindi: वित्तीय योजना एवं विश्लेषण — बजट, पूर्वानुमान और प्रदर्शन-विश्लेषण करने वाली वित्त टीम
definition: financial planning and analysis; the finance team that builds budgets, forecasts and explains variances to leadership
example: FP&A sent the forecast template back for the third time, now with conditional formatting.

hindi: पूर्ण मूल्य-समायोजन — सस्ते राउंड पर निवेशक की कीमत सीधे नई कीमत तक गिराना
definition: the harshest anti-dilution protection, resetting an investor's conversion price to the lower price of any later down round
example: One full ratchet and a bad quarter later, the founders owned roughly the office plants.

hindi: पूर्ण-चक्र विक्रेता — शुरुआत से हस्ताक्षर तक सौदा खुद चलाने वाला
definition: account executive who prospects, qualifies, demos and closes deals personally, without separate development reps
example: As a full-cycle AE he books his own meetings, runs his own demos and blames only himself.

hindi: काम का भविष्य — तकनीक से बदलते कामकाज पर कॉर्पोरेट चर्चा
definition: the corporate conversation about how technology, remote arrangements and automation will reshape jobs and offices
example: The future of work panel ran forty minutes over, which felt like the present of work.

hindi: जैसा डालोगे वैसा पाओगे — ख़राब डेटा से कभी अच्छे नतीजे नहीं निकलते
definition: the principle that flawed or poor-quality input data will always produce flawed analysis, reports and decisions, however clever the model
example: We spent a million on the model and forgot garbage in, garbage out.

hindi: हरितगृह गैस लेखा मानक — उत्सर्जन मापने और रिपोर्ट करने का मानक ढाँचा
definition: greenhouse accounting standard that companies follow for measuring and reporting emissions across three scopes
example: According to the GHG Protocol, your commute counts; according to the canteen, so does your burger.

hindi: भूतिया आरक्षण — बुक किया कमरा जिसमें कोई आता ही नहीं
definition: a meeting room or desk reservation that nobody shows up to use, blocking space for others
example: The weekly sync was cancelled in March, but its ghost booking still haunts room 4B every Thursday.

hindi: कुछ दो, कुछ लो — मोलभाव में हर छूट के बदले कुछ माँगना
definition: the negotiation rule that every concession offered to a buyer must be traded for something in return
example: The discount was a give-get: they received ten percent, we received a logo on our website.

hindi: लंबी पोज़ीशन लेना — भाव बढ़ने की उम्मीद में ख़रीदना या समर्थन करना
definition: buying or backing something expecting its price or value to rise over time
example: I'd go long on the platform team; I'd short anything with blockchain in the pitch.

hindi: अनावश्यक चमक — माँगे बिना जोड़ी गई अतिरिक्त पॉलिश
definition: adding unrequested polish or features beyond what the requirements asked for
example: The button animates beautifully; nobody asked; classic gold-plating.

hindi: स्वर्ण सेट — जाँच के लिए प्रमाणित उत्तरों वाला भरोसेमंद नमूना-समूह
definition: a small, trusted set of examples with verified answers used to judge models
example: The golden set is fifty workouts the physio labeled personally; guard it.

hindi: सक्रियता संकेत — चैट ऐप में ऑनलाइन दिखने का निशान, जिसे काम का सबूत माना जाता है
definition: chat application's active status indicator, treated by remote teams and managers as proof someone is working
example: She stepped away for four minutes and came back to three messages asking where her green dot went.

hindi: मुक्ति-भुगतान — अधिग्रहण की धमकी देने वाले से ऊँचे दाम पर शेयर वापस ख़रीदना
definition: paying a hostile raider a premium to repurchase their shares so they abandon a takeover attempt
example: Shareholders called the buyback greenmail; the press release called it strategic capital allocation.

hindi: हरित दिखावा — पर्यावरण-हितैषी होने के बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर किए गए दावे
definition: overstating environmental credentials through marketing claims that company operations cannot actually support
example: The recycled-paper brochure announcing our green transformation was printed for a fleet of diesel trucks.

hindi: सकल से शुद्ध — सूची-मूल्य से छूट, वापसी आदि घटाकर असली राजस्व तक पहुँचना
definition: reconciliation from gross sales at list price down to actual revenue after discounts, rebates, returns and allowances
example: The gross-to-net bridge showed that half of our list price exists purely for negotiation.

hindi: यथार्थ सत्य — प्रशिक्षण और जाँच के लिए प्रमाणित सही उत्तर
definition: the verified correct answer used to train models and score their outputs
example: We need ground truth for 'good form', so film the physiotherapist, not the intern.

hindi: किसी भी क़ीमत पर विकास — घाटे की परवाह किए बिना तेज़ विस्तार की रणनीति
definition: a strategy prioritising rapid user and revenue growth regardless of losses, burn rate or unit economics
example: Growth at all costs worked beautifully right up until someone read the costs.

hindi: जुगाड़ू विकास तरकीबें — कम ख़र्च में तेज़ी से उपयोगकर्ता बढ़ाना
definition: scrappy, experiment-driven tactics to grow users fast on a small budget
example: Our growth hacking budget is one intern and unlimited enthusiasm.

hindi: मार्गदर्शन अनुमान — कंपनी का निवेशकों को दिया आधिकारिक आय-अनुमान
definition: a public company's official forecast of future revenue or earnings, shared with investors and analysts
example: We beat guidance, mainly because guidance was set somewhere near the floor.

hindi: अनुमान घटाना — आगामी कमाई का पूर्वानुमान कम करना
definition: management lowering its official revenue or earnings forecast for coming periods, typically triggering a share price drop
example: They guided down on Tuesday and called it a reset on Wednesday.

hindi: मतिभ्रम — एआई का आत्मविश्वास से ग़लत जानकारी गढ़ना
definition: an AI system confidently producing information that is false or made up
example: It recommended a 45-minute plank and cited a fake study — textbook hallucination.

hindi: गलियारा परीक्षण — पास बैठे किसी से भी झटपट जाँच
definition: quick informal usability testing with whoever happens to be nearby, usually colleagues outside the project
example: Hallway testing with the finance team found the flaw in four minutes that three sprints had missed.

hindi: कठोर अवतरण — तेज़ी के बाद अर्थव्यवस्था का मंदी में गिरना
definition: when an economic slowdown after rapid growth tips sharply into recession rather than cooling gently
example: Planning assumed a soft landing; the hiring freeze suggests someone upstairs expects a hard landing.

hindi: ठोस बचत — बजट में सचमुच दिखने वाली खर्च की कमी
definition: savings that measurably reduce actual spending on the books compared with the previous period
example: Finance only counts hard savings, which is why the productivity gains never made the slide.

hindi: ढाँचागत सेवाएँ — बिजली, एसी, लिफ़्ट जैसी इमारत की भौतिक देखरेख
definition: facilities management services that maintain building systems, such as heating, cooling, electrical, plumbing and lifts
example: Hard services fixed the air conditioning in a week, precisely as winter arrived.

hindi: प्रतिकूल हवाएँ — कारोबार को धीमा करने वाली बाहरी परिस्थितियाँ
definition: external business conditions slowing revenue growth or squeezing margins, cited on earnings calls to explain weaker results
example: The CFO listed seven headwinds, none of which was the product.

hindi: खाता स्वास्थ्य जाँच — ग्राहक की स्थिति परखने के लिए नियमित समीक्षा कॉल
definition: scheduled customer success review assessing product usage, satisfaction and renewal risks within an account, usually through a structured call
example: The health check went great until the customer asked who we were.

hindi: ग्राहक स्वास्थ्य अंक — खाते की स्थिति का संकेतक
definition: a composite metric estimating how happy and sticky a customer account is
example: The health score was green right up until the cancellation email.

hindi: अनुभवजन्य समीक्षा — मानक कसौटियों पर विशेषज्ञ की जाँच
definition: an expert review scoring an interface against established usability rules
example: The heuristic evaluation flagged everything the launch deadline had approved.

hindi: उच्च संभावना वाला — भविष्य का नेता माना गया कर्मचारी
definition: an employee flagged by leadership as capable of future senior roles, often given special development programs
example: Being tagged high potential meant more training, more projects, and exactly the same salary.

hindi: मीटिंग पर कब्ज़ा — बैठक को अपने विषय की ओर मोड़ देना
definition: steering a meeting away from its agenda toward someone's own topic or complaint
example: He hijacked the meeting to debate the logo, and the launch went unplanned.

hindi: कलम थामना — दस्तावेज़ का मसौदा लिखने की ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
definition: being the single person responsible for drafting and editing a shared document while others send comments
example: Everyone had opinions on the deck, but only the associate had to hold the pen, which meant holding the blame.

hindi: सींग प्रभाव — एक कमी से पूरे व्यक्ति को कमतर आँकना
definition: rating bias where a single mistake or dislikable trait drags down a reviewer's judgement of overall performance
example: One outage in March produced a horns effect that lasted through December.

hindi: उत्तराधिकार की दौड़ — शीर्ष पद के लिए कई आंतरिक दावेदारों के बीच खुली प्रतिस्पर्धा
definition: a succession contest where several internal executives openly compete for the chief executive role until the board picks one winner
example: The CEO horse race ended on Friday with one winner and two resignation letters.

hindi: हम कैसे कर सकते हैं — समस्या को अवसर-प्रश्न में बदलना
definition: a framing that rewrites a user problem as an open question inviting solutions, used in design workshops
example: How might we reduce onboarding drop-off, asked the sticky note, beside another reading 'fewer screens?'.

hindi: केंद्र और शाखाएँ — एक मुख्य दफ़्तर के साथ छोटे क्षेत्रीय दफ़्तरों वाला मॉडल
definition: workplace model pairing one central headquarters office with smaller regional satellite offices near where employees live
example: Under hub and spoke, the spoke office has great coffee and every decision still happens at the hub.

hindi: अटका सौदा — बैंक द्वारा वादा किया कर्ज़ जो बाज़ार में बिक न सका
definition: a financing that banks committed to underwrite but cannot sell to investors at the agreed terms
example: The hung deal sat on the balance sheet all quarter, and nobody mentioned it at the holiday party.

hindi: न्यूनतम प्रतिफल दर — निवेश मंज़ूरी के लिए ज़रूरी न्यूनतम रिटर्न
definition: the minimum expected return a project must promise before finance will approve the investment
example: The project cleared the hurdle rate after someone adjusted the adoption assumptions twice.

hindi: प्रचार चक्र — नई तकनीक पर उत्साह, निराशा और फिर स्थिरता का दौर
definition: the familiar pattern where emerging technology draws inflated excitement, then disappointment, then quieter practical adoption
example: Leadership asked where we sit on the hype cycle, which means someone read a Gartner report.

hindi: प्रभाव का दिखावा — सामाजिक या पर्यावरणीय असर के खोखले दावे
definition: overstating the social or environmental impact claimed by an investment, product or programme beyond what evidence supports
example: The fund's impact washing counted every loan to a coffee shop as poverty alleviation.

hindi: आंतरिक खुला स्रोत — कंपनी के भीतर खुले स्रोत की तरह टीमों का एक-दूसरे के कोड में योगदान
definition: applying open-source practices inside a company, letting any team read and contribute to another team's code
example: Under inner source, you may now submit fixes to the team that ignores your tickets.

hindi: दूरस्थ बिक्री — फ़ोन और वीडियो कॉल से दूर बैठकर बिक्री
definition: selling remotely through phone, email and video calls rather than visiting customers in person
example: Inside sales closed more this quarter than field sales, and without a single airport lounge receipt.

hindi: सूचित करना — औपचारिक रूप से किसी को ख़बर देना
definition: an Indian English formal verb meaning to inform someone officially, often about leave, changes or decisions
example: Please intimate your manager before taking leave, not from the airport lounge.

hindi: संस्था के भीतर उद्यमी — कंपनी के अंदर रहकर नए उत्पाद या उद्यम खड़े करने वाला
definition: an employee who builds new products or ventures inside an established company with startup-style initiative
example: The intrapreneur pitched a new business unit, which legal is still reviewing eighteen months later.

hindi: भंडार आवर्तन — साल में कितनी बार पूरा माल बिककर बदला
definition: how many times inventory sells through and gets replaced within a year, showing how efficiently stock moves
example: Inventory turns improved dramatically once someone found the second warehouse.

hindi: मुद्दा-वृक्ष — बड़े सवाल को छोटे उप-सवालों की शाखाओं में तोड़ना
definition: a branching diagram that breaks one large business question into smaller, narrower questions until each can be answered with analysis
example: The issue tree had forty branches and one leaf that anyone had actually researched.

hindi: झटकेदार चाल — एनिमेशन या स्क्रॉल का अटकना
definition: visible stutter or lag in scrolling, animation or transitions that makes an interface feel broken
example: The new transition added charm on the designer's laptop and jank on every phone we tested.

hindi: जुगाड़ — सीमित साधनों से निकाला गया कामचलाऊ, चतुर समाधान
definition: an Indian English borrowing for a clever improvised workaround built with limited resources, often temporary but durable
example: The production server runs on a cron job, a spreadsheet and pure jugaad.

hindi: न्यायसंगत संक्रमण — कम-कार्बन बदलाव में कर्मचारियों और समुदायों को पीछे न छोड़ना
definition: principle that shifting toward cleaner operations should protect affected workers and communities through retraining, support and fair treatment
example: Our just transition slide shows smiling retrained workers; the budget line shows a question mark.

hindi: निरंतर सुधार — रोज़ के छोटे-छोटे बदलावों से प्रक्रिया बेहतर करना
definition: continuous improvement through small, frequent changes suggested by the people doing the work, borrowed from Japanese lean practice
example: Our kaizen event produced forty sticky notes and one relocated stapler.

hindi: ज्ञान सीमा-तिथि — इस तारीख़ के बाद की दुनिया से मॉडल अनजान
definition: the date after which a model's training data ends and it knows nothing
example: It recommends last year's fitness trends — blame the knowledge cutoff.

hindi: निष्कर्ष की सीढ़ी — चुनिंदा तथ्यों से छलांग लगाकर धारणाएँ बना लेने का मॉडल
definition: a model showing how people climb from selected facts through assumptions to firm conclusions and actions, used to challenge hasty judgements
example: He saw one late reply and climbed the whole ladder of inference to disengagement by lunch.

hindi: ज़मीन हथियाना — ख़ाली ज़िम्मेदारी या नए प्रोजेक्ट पर झट से कब्ज़ा
definition: a quick move to claim ownership of an unclaimed project, product area or headcount before rival teams do
example: The AI strategy memo was barely sent when the land grab for owning it began.

hindi: अभियान-पृष्ठ — एक ही कार्रवाई के लिए बना वेबपेज
definition: a single-purpose web page built to convert a campaign's visitors into leads
example: The landing page has one button and, somehow, three stakeholders.

hindi: अनुभवी भर्ती — दूसरी कंपनी से समान स्तर पर लाया गया कर्मचारी
definition: an experienced professional hired from another company at a comparable level rather than from campus
example: As a lateral hire he got a higher salary and none of the tribal knowledge.

hindi: छँटनी से बचे लोगों का तनाव — छँटनी के बाद बचे कर्मचारियों की ग्लानि और डर
definition: guilt, anxiety and lowered morale among employees who keep their jobs after colleagues are laid off
example: Layoff survivor syndrome looks like everyone replying instantly and nobody taking lunch.

hindi: संभावित ग्राहक — जिसने उत्पाद में रुचि दिखाई हो
definition: a person or company that has shown interest and might become a customer
example: Half the leads from the webinar were students and one was our own intern.

hindi: लीड सृजन — संभावित ग्राहकों की जानकारी जुटाना
definition: lead generation — activities that collect contact info from potential buyers
example: The ebook is lead gen: twelve pages of content, one page of form.

hindi: रैंकिंग तालिका — सौदों या शुल्क के आधार पर बैंकों की क्रम-सूची
definition: a ranking of banks by deal volume or fees, cited endlessly in pitches and bonus discussions
example: We were number one in the league table, provided you filtered for mid-cap Nordic healthcare in March.

hindi: छुट्टी में भी काम — छुट्टी या बीमारी के दिनों में काम निपटाना
definition: using annual leave or sick days to catch up on work, or working while officially away
example: Her leaveism was so thorough that the out-of-office reply answered within minutes.

hindi: एल्गोरिद्म पहेली परीक्षा — रटे हुए कोडिंग प्रश्नों पर आधारित साक्षात्कार
definition: shorthand for algorithm-puzzle coding interviews, named after the practice site candidates grind before them
example: He did two hundred LeetCode problems to get a job fixing CSS.

hindi: लाइसेंस लेखा-परीक्षा — विक्रेता द्वारा जाँच कि ग्राहक ख़रीदे गए से अधिक उपयोग तो नहीं कर रहा
definition: a vendor's formal review of a customer's software usage against purchased licences, often ending in back-billing
example: The license audit found we were using thirty more seats, which conveniently equalled their quarterly target.

hindi: दायित्व की सीमा — अनुबंध में अधिकतम हर्जाने की तय हद
definition: the contract clause capping the total money either party must pay the other when something goes wrong, usually excluding certain damages
example: The deal closed in a week; the limitation of liability took the other five.

hindi: परिसमापन ढेर — निवेशकों की कुल वरीयताएँ जो बिक्री में पहले चुकानी हैं
definition: the combined liquidation preferences of every funding round, which must be repaid before common shareholders receive anything
example: We sold for two hundred million; the liquidation stack was two hundred and ten.

hindi: सबसे सस्ता समझदार किराया — नियमानुसार वाजिब सबसे कम हवाई किराया
definition: the cheapest reasonable airfare a travel policy expects employees to book, allowing for sensible times and connections
example: The lowest logical fare left at 5 a.m. with two connections, and finance called that logical.

hindi: आंशिक ट्रक-भार — कई ग्राहकों का माल एक ट्रक में साझा ढुलाई
definition: less than truckload; freight shipments too small to fill a trailer, consolidated with other shippers' goods
example: Shipping LTL saved money and added three surprise stops in cities nobody mentioned.

hindi: पिछले साल दिया, इस साल नहीं — दोबारा जोड़े जाने योग्य पुराने दाता
definition: last year but unfortunately not this; donors who gave during the previous year but have not yet given during the current year
example: December is when the whole development team starts treating the LYBUNT report like a hostage list.

hindi: इसे उभारो — अस्पष्ट माँग कि डिज़ाइन ज़्यादा आकर्षक दिखे
definition: vague stakeholder feedback asking that a design look bolder or more exciting, without saying how
example: The client asked us to make it pop, so we made it orange, and now they want it to pop less.

hindi: मानव-दिवस — एक व्यक्ति के एक दिन के काम की इकाई
definition: an effort estimation unit counting work as days of one person, used heavily in services proposals, staffing plans and billing
example: Forty man-days, the estimate said, assuming nobody takes a comp off.

hindi: बिना निकाले इस्तीफे की ओर धकेलना
definition: engineering someone's exit through pressure and paperwork instead of firing them
example: No one fired him; managing out just made staying unbearable.

hindi: सात-तत्व संगठन ढाँचा — संगठन के सात जुड़े पहलुओं का तालमेल परखना
definition: a framework assessing organisational alignment across strategy, structure, systems, shared values, style, staff and skills
example: The McKinsey 7S review found all seven elements misaligned, which at least made them consistent.

hindi: नकल जैसी दवा — पहले से मौजूद दवा जैसी ही नई दवा
definition: a drug that works through the same mechanism as an existing approved medicine, differing only slightly in chemistry or dosing
example: Marketing banned the phrase me-too drug and replaced it with 'differentiated option', which cost forty slides.

hindi: माध्यम-मिश्रण — बजट का विभिन्न चैनलों में बँटवारा
definition: the combination of advertising channels, such as television, search, social, outdoor and print, chosen for a campaign and the budget split between them
example: The media mix is sixty percent social, because the director's nephew said television is dead.

hindi: संदेश वापसी — भेजी ईमेल को वापस लेने की कोशिश
definition: email feature attempting to withdraw a sent message, which mostly alerts everyone to read it
example: The message recall notice made sure all two hundred people read the original.

hindi: बहु-स्तरीय पहचान जाँच — पासवर्ड के साथ फ़ोन या कोड से दूसरी पुष्टि
definition: multi-factor authentication; login requiring password plus second proof like phone approval or code
example: MFA means the laptop is secure and also useless when your phone is in the other room.

hindi: सूक्ष्म प्रभावक — छोटे पर सक्रिय दर्शक वर्ग वाला क्रिएटर
definition: creator with a small but highly engaged niche following, typically between ten thousand and one hundred thousand followers
example: We swapped one celebrity for forty micro-influencers and forty times the invoices.

hindi: हर छोटे काम पर नियंत्रण — भरोसे की जगह निगरानी
definition: supervising every small detail instead of trusting people with outcomes
example: The micromanagement was so thorough it needed its own status meeting.

hindi: ध्येय-समर्पित कर्मी — जो पैसे से ज़्यादा कंपनी के उद्देश्य में विश्वास के कारण काम करता है
definition: an employee or founder driven by genuine belief in the company's mission rather than money
example: Hire missionaries, the VC said, while offering the missionaries below-market salaries.

hindi: सक्रिय समर्थक — ग्राहक के भीतर वह व्यक्ति जो सौदे के लिए सहमति जुटाता है
definition: a stakeholder inside the buying account who actively builds internal consensus and drives the purchase decision forward
example: He liked our demo; a mobilizer would have booked the meeting with finance.

hindi: मॉडल — डेटा से सीखा हुआ तंत्र जो इनपुट से अनुमान या उत्तर बनाता है
definition: a trained system that turns input data into predictions or generated output
example: The new model nails squats but still thinks a lunge is a yoga pose.

hindi: मॉडल कार्ड — मॉडल का उद्देश्य, डेटा और सीमाएँ बताने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: a short document describing a model's purpose, training data, limits, and risks
example: The model card admits it struggles with pilates; respect the honesty.

hindi: चिह्नित बड़ा ग्राहक — विशेष रणनीति वाला खाता
definition: a high-value target company assigned to a specific rep with a specific plan
example: It's a named account, which means two VPs also claim credit for it.

hindi: सुधार आवश्यक — समीक्षा की निचली रेटिंग
definition: the performance rating below meets expectations, often the formal first step toward a performance improvement plan
example: 'Needs improvement' was printed in the same cheerful font as everything else in the review.

hindi: दिलचस्प जाल में फँसाना — ऐसी पहेली फेंकना कि इंजीनियर सब छोड़ बैठे
definition: to derail an engineer by presenting a problem too interesting to ignore
example: One casual puzzle nerd-sniped three engineers for an afternoon.

hindi: नया सदस्य — जिसने हाल ही में कंपनी जॉइन की हो
definition: an employee who has recently joined the company, regardless of experience level; standard Indian English usage
example: Please add the new joinees to the team channel before they discover the old one.

hindi: अदेयता प्रमाण पत्र — हर विभाग से कोई बकाया न होने की पुष्टि
definition: in Indian English, exit clearance confirming a leaving employee owes nothing to finance, admin or information technology
example: Getting the no dues certificate took longer than serving the entire notice period.

hindi: बिना क्रय आदेश भुगतान नहीं — बिना स्वीकृत आदेश के आए बिल का भुगतान रोकने की नीति
definition: procurement policy that invoices arriving without a matching approved purchase order will not be paid
example: The vendor learned about no PO, no pay the day their invoice bounced for the third time.

hindi: कहीं और न जाने की शर्त — टर्म शीट के बाद दूसरे निवेशकों से बात पर रोक
definition: a term sheet provision barring founders from soliciting other investors or offers during an exclusivity period while diligence runs
example: The no-shop clause arrived thirty minutes before a better offer did.
