hindi: न रोकने वाला — ऐसी समीक्षा टिप्पणी जो सुझाव है, विलय की शर्त नहीं
definition: describing a review comment offered as a suggestion that does not need resolving before the pull request merges
example: Non-blocking, but have you considered rewriting the whole thing in a different language?

hindi: गैर-मानक आँकड़े — प्रबंधन द्वारा समायोजित वित्तीय माप
definition: describing financial figures adjusted by management outside standard accounting rules, typically excluding stock compensation and non-recurring charges
example: The non-GAAP profit was lovely, largely because it excluded everything that cost money.

hindi: अखेदजनक पलायन — ऐसे लोगों का जाना जिनके जाने से कंपनी को फ़र्क नहीं पड़ता
definition: departures of employees the company was content to lose, often weaker performers or roles planned away
example: HR counted his exit as non-regrettable attrition, which he found in the leaked slide.

hindi: न लुभाने की शर्त — एक-दूसरे के कर्मचारी या ग्राहक न तोड़ने का वचन
definition: a clause barring a party or departing employee from recruiting the other side's staff or poaching its customers for a period
example: The non-solicit lasted twelve months, so the recruiter's LinkedIn message arrived on day three hundred sixty-six.

hindi: रेटिंग समायोजन — टीमों की रेटिंग को तय वितरण में बिठाना
definition: in Indian English, the appraisal step where managers adjust ratings across teams to match the mandated bell curve
example: His rating went in as a four and came out of normalization as a three with no explanation attached.

hindi: ध्रुवतारा मापदंड — कंपनी की असली प्रगति दिखाने वाला एक प्रमुख आँकड़ा
definition: the single metric a company treats as its truest measure of value delivered
example: We changed our north-star metric twice this year, which says something.

hindi: यहाँ नहीं बना — बाहर बनी चीज़ को ठुकराकर सब कुछ ख़ुद बनाने की ज़िद
definition: the reflex of rejecting outside tools or libraries and rebuilding them in-house because someone else wrote them
example: Pure not invented here: we now maintain our own date library, and it thinks February has thirty days.

hindi: उत्तर अपेक्षित नहीं — जवाब देने की ज़रूरत नहीं, केवल सूचना
definition: no reply necessary; email subject tag telling recipients the message is purely informational and expects no response
example: Subject: Office closed Friday (NRN) — which is why nobody replied, and why forty people replied anyway.

hindi: खुला भर्ती अभियान — किसी भी कॉलेज के स्नातकों के लिए कॉलेज से बाहर आयोजित
definition: in Indian English, a recruitment event open to graduates from any college, held outside the campus placement process
example: Two thousand candidates turned up to the off-campus drive for forty seats and one working projector.

hindi: अनधिकृत उपयोग वाला — स्वीकृति से बाहर की बीमारी में दवा का प्रयोग
definition: describing prescribing a drug for conditions, doses or patients outside its approved labeling, which companies must never promote
example: Sales asked whether they could mention the off-label data if the doctor asked first, and compliance aged a decade.

hindi: हमारा दस्तावेज़ — सौदा अपने ही अनुबंध टेम्पलेट पर करवाना
definition: negotiation shorthand for using your own company's contract template rather than the counterparty's, which controls the starting terms
example: We'll only agree to the pilot if it's on our paper, said the lawyer who wrote our paper.

hindi: बिना परियोजना — किसी ग्राहक काम पर न लगा सलाहकार
definition: a consultant currently between client projects, paid but not assigned, waiting to be staffed
example: Three weeks on the beach and he'd reformatted every template the firm owns.

hindi: एकमुश्त शुल्क — असामान्य खर्च जिसे दोहराया न जाने वाला बताया जाता है
definition: an expense presented as unusual and non-recurring, such as restructuring or litigation, often excluded from adjusted earnings
example: This is our fourth one-time charge in two years, which makes it a fairly regular one-time.

hindi: विदेश तैनाती का अवसर — ग्राहक के देश में जाकर काम करने का मौका
definition: in Indian English, a chance to work at the client location abroad, prized for salary, allowances and visa experience
example: He was promised an onsite opportunity at every appraisal for five years running.

hindi: देखो-समझो-तय करो-करो चक्र — तेज़ी से बदलती स्थिति में फ़ैसले का चक्र
definition: observe, orient, decide, act; a rapid decision cycle for acting faster than competitors in changing conditions
example: Our OODA loop is fine; it's just stuck on orient since March.

hindi: संचालक — कंपनी को सचमुच चलाने-बढ़ाने का अनुभव रखने वाला
definition: someone who has actually run and scaled companies, not just invested or advised
example: We wanted an operator on the board, not another spreadsheet enthusiast.

hindi: कर्मचारी शेयर कोष — भावी कर्मचारियों के लिए अलग रखे शेयर
definition: shares set aside to grant future employees, usually carved out before a round
example: The investors asked us to enlarge the option pool from our side.

hindi: बहिर्नियोजन सहायता — निकाले गए कर्मचारियों को नई नौकरी खोजने में मदद
definition: employer-funded help for dismissed employees finding fresh positions, including resume coaching and career counselling
example: Outplacement offered a resume workshop run by someone laid off last spring.

hindi: अपने माध्यम — कंपनी के स्वयं के नियंत्रण वाले चैनल
definition: marketing channels the company controls outright, such as its website, blog, newsletter, mobile application and social accounts, with no media spend required
example: The newsletter is owned media, which is why nobody can explain why it costs so much.

hindi: ख़रीद कार्ड — छोटी कंपनी ख़रीद के लिए दिया गया कॉरपोरेट कार्ड
definition: procurement card; a company payment card for small business purchases that skips the purchase order process
example: The P-card limit is five hundred dollars, which explains the three separate four-hundred-dollar chair orders.

hindi: आपात बुलावा भेजना — रात-दिन कभी भी ड्यूटी वाले इंजीनियर को तुरंत चेतावनी भेजकर बुलाना
definition: to trigger an urgent alert that wakes or interrupts the on-call engineer and demands an immediate response
example: The disk filled up at four, so naturally it paged the one person on holiday.

hindi: काम-फैलाव नियम — काम उतना फैल जाता है जितना समय उसे दिया जाए
definition: observation that work expands to fill whatever time is available for its completion
example: Given a month for a one-pager, Parkinson's law delivered it at 11:58 pm on day thirty.

hindi: सुधार संस्करण — बिना नई सुविधाओं के सिर्फ़ त्रुटियाँ ठीक करने वाला छोटा संस्करण
definition: a small version containing only fixes for defects, shipped without new features after a main release
example: The patch release fixed the crash and introduced a charming new one.

hindi: सुधार-मंगलवार — हर महीने सुरक्षा अपडेट और ज़बरन रीस्टार्ट का दिन
definition: monthly Microsoft security update release, bringing company-wide forced laptop restarts and installation reminders
example: Patch Tuesday restarted his laptop mid-presentation, which at least ended the questions.

hindi: एकाधिकार की ढलान — संरक्षण ख़त्म होते ही दवा की बिक्री का अचानक गिरना
definition: the steep revenue drop when patents protecting a bestselling drug expire and cheaper generic copies flood the market
example: The strategy offsite was called 'Beyond 2029', which everyone understood to mean the patent cliff.

hindi: ढर्रा-तोड़ शुरुआत — कोल्ड कॉल में अप्रत्याशित पंक्ति से सामने वाले का ध्यान खींचना
definition: an unexpected opening line in a cold call or email designed to break the prospect's automatic brush-off response
example: His pattern interrupt was admitting it was a cold call, which the prospect found refreshing for eleven seconds.

hindi: नियामक निर्णय तिथि — जिस दिन अमेरिकी नियामक दवा पर फ़ैसला देगा
definition: prescription Drug User Fee Act date; the deadline by which American regulators must decide whether to approve a submitted drug application
example: The launch team counts down to the PDUFA date the way children count down to birthdays, with more caffeine.

hindi: प्रति-सीट मूल्य — हर उपयोगकर्ता के हिसाब से शुल्क
definition: software pricing charged for each named user license, regardless of how much each person actually uses
example: Per-seat pricing made sense until the agents started doing the seats' work.

hindi: पीटर सिद्धांत — लोग अपनी अक्षमता के स्तर तक तरक्की पाते हैं
definition: the observation that employees keep getting promoted until they reach a role they cannot perform
example: The best engineer became the worst director, a textbook Peter principle promotion.

hindi: पालतू बनाम मवेशी — सर्वर सहेजो मत, बदल डालो का सिद्धांत
definition: treat servers as replaceable herd members, not beloved pets nursed back to health
example: Pets vs cattle, yet here we are, hand-feeding server number seven.

hindi: नकली फ़िशिंग परीक्षण — कर्मचारियों की सतर्कता जाँचने को भेजा गया जाल-ईमेल
definition: fake scam email sent by the security team to test whether employees click suspicious links
example: The phishing simulation promised a free pizza voucher, and half of finance is now booked into remedial training.

hindi: पाइपलाइन सफ़ाई — मृत या फूले हुए सौदे हटाने की कवायद
definition: cleaning pipeline records by closing dead deals and correcting inflated amounts or unrealistic dates
example: After the pipeline scrub, coverage dropped from four times to a number nobody said aloud.

hindi: पिक्सेल खिसकाना — छोटी दृश्य बारीकियों पर अटके रहना
definition: endless small visual adjustments to spacing and alignment, often while bigger product questions stay unanswered
example: Two days of pixel pushing on the settings screen, and nobody has asked whether users ever open it.

hindi: संतुलन आँकड़ा — मॉडल को मिलाने के लिए डाली गई संख्या
definition: a balancing figure forced into a financial model or forecast so the totals reach the required target
example: The gap to plan was closed with a plug labelled new initiatives, with no initiatives attached.

hindi: जेब में वीटो — जवाब न देकर चुपचाप किसी प्रस्ताव को मार देना
definition: killing a proposal or decision by quietly never responding to it rather than openly rejecting it
example: The budget request wasn't rejected; it received a pocket veto and a very busy calendar.

hindi: निवेश-पश्चात SAFE — निवेशक का हिस्सा पैसा आने के बाद के मूल्यांकन पर तय
definition: the standard modern SAFE, fixing investor ownership against the valuation after all SAFE money converts, so founders absorb the dilution
example: The founders stacked four post-money SAFEs and discovered each one diluted them, not each other.

hindi: उत्तर-प्रशिक्षण — मूल प्रशिक्षण के बाद मॉडल को उपयोगी बनाने का काम
definition: everything done after pretraining — fine-tuning, feedback, safety work — to make a model useful
example: The base model was raw talent; post-training taught it manners.

hindi: पूर्व-पुष्टि करना — प्रस्ताव से पहले उम्मीदवार की स्वीकृति टटोलना
definition: to confirm a candidate would accept specific terms before the formal offer is made
example: Always pre-close on salary, or you will learn about the competing offer from the rejection.

hindi: पूर्व-समीक्षा — शुरू से पहले संभावित विफलता के कारणों की कल्पना
definition: imagining a project has already failed, then listing why, before it starts
example: The pre-mortem predicted everything except how right it was.

hindi: यात्रा-पूर्व स्वीकृति — टिकट बुक करने से पहले मैनेजर की अनुमति
definition: manager sign-off required before booking business travel, confirming the trip purpose and estimated costs
example: Pre-trip approval arrived the day after I landed, which I am choosing to call alignment.

hindi: पहले से मनाना — मीटिंग से पहले हितधारकों को अलग-अलग राज़ी करना
definition: briefing key stakeholders individually before a meeting so decisions face no surprises in the room
example: I pre-wired the VP, so the decision meeting is really a formality with slides.

hindi: पूर्व सौदे — पिछले अधिग्रहणों के मूल्य से वर्तमान कंपनी का मूल्यांकन
definition: valuing a company using multiples paid in previous acquisitions of similar businesses
example: The precedent transactions dated back to 2007, a vintage the client found very flattering.

hindi: मूल्य सूची पुस्तिका — हर उत्पाद और योजना की आधिकारिक कीमतें
definition: the official internal catalogue of products, plans and approved prices that sales quotes are built from
example: The price book said two hundred per seat; the rep's heart said whatever closes by Friday.

hindi: लक्ष्य मूल्य — विश्लेषक का अनुमानित भावी शेयर भाव
definition: analyst's forecast of where a share price should trade within twelve months, published alongside their rating
example: Three brokers raised their price target the morning after the stock had already doubled.

hindi: भाव में शामिल — खबर का असर पहले से कीमत में आ चुका होना
definition: already reflected in the current price because investors expected the news beforehand
example: The layoff announcement was priced in; the stock had dropped the week the offsite got cancelled.

hindi: आनुपातिक अधिकार — अगले दौर में हिस्सा बनाए रखने का हक़
definition: an investor's right to keep their ownership percentage by joining future rounds
example: The angel exercised her pro rata; she likes owning exactly one percent.

hindi: मुफ़्त उत्पाद बँटाई — इस उम्मीद में क्रिएटरों को सामान भेजना कि वे ज़िक्र करें
definition: sending free products to creators without payment, hoping they will mention or review them voluntarily
example: The product seeding campaign shipped two hundred boxes and produced one unboxing, filmed by the intern's cousin.

hindi: उत्पाद-आधारित बिक्री — मुफ़्त उपयोगकर्ताओं के संकेतों पर सेल्स का संपर्क
definition: a hybrid motion where sales teams target accounts already using a free or self-serve product, prioritized by usage signals
example: Product-led sales means the rep calls you right after your third login.

hindi: स्वचालित विज्ञापन-ख़रीद वाला — सॉफ़्टवेयर नीलामी से पल भर में ख़रीदे गए विज्ञापन
definition: describing advertising bought automatically through software auctions in real time, rather than negotiated directly with publishers
example: The programmatic campaign placed our banking advertisement beside a quiz about which cheese you are.

hindi: पदोन्नति समिति — तरक्की के मामलों पर फ़ैसला करने वाला समूह
definition: the group of senior leaders who read promotion cases and decide which candidates advance a level
example: The promo committee spent four minutes on his case and forty on whether the rubric needed a font change.

hindi: पदोन्नति-प्रेरित विकास — तरक्की के लिए नई चीज़ें बनाना, पुरानी सँभालना नहीं
definition: building shiny launches that look good in promotion cases while maintenance work nobody gets credit for decays
example: Three internal chat apps exist because of promo-driven development, and none of them has an owner.

hindi: प्रमाण-बिंदु — दावे को सही ठहराने वाले तथ्य
definition: specific facts, statistics, customer results or features that substantiate a marketing claim and support each pillar of the messaging
example: We claim to be the fastest; the proof points team is still looking for evidence.

hindi: वीटो अधिकार — कुछ बड़े फ़ैसलों पर निवेशकों की सहमति ज़रूरी
definition: investor veto rights over major company actions such as selling, raising money, issuing senior shares or changing the charter
example: The founder learned about the protective provisions the day he tried to raise a bridge without asking.

hindi: सार्वजनिक सूचना — पूरी टीम के लिए ज़रूरी चेतावनी
definition: public service announcement; chat heading for a general warning or tip meant for the whole team
example: PSA: the coffee machine is broken again, the most-reacted message of the week.

hindi: आगे खींचना — अगली तिमाही का सौदा इसी तिमाही में बंद करवाना
definition: persuading a customer to sign earlier, moving a deal into the current quarter
example: To pull in the deal, we offered a discount so generous the customer asked if we were okay.

hindi: चढ़ाओ और बेचो — प्रचार से भाव बढ़ाकर ऊँचे पर बेच निकलना
definition: hyping an asset to inflate its price, then selling holdings before the price collapses
example: That influencer's token was a pump and dump with an unusually good logo.

hindi: बैंगनी गिलहरी — ऐसा उम्मीदवार जिसकी हर योग्यता असंभव रूप से सटीक हो
definition: a candidate matching every requirement of an unrealistically specific role, and therefore nearly impossible to find
example: Fluent Mandarin, Kubernetes, and ten years in dental billing: we are hunting a purple squirrel.

hindi: परखा हुआ संभावित ग्राहक — बजट और ज़रूरत की पुष्टि के बाद
definition: a lead vetted for budget, need, and authority before sales spends time on it
example: It's only a qualified lead if someone besides the intern answered the email.

hindi: परिमाणीकरण — मॉडल के अंकों की परिशुद्धता घटाकर उसे हल्का-तेज़ बनाना
definition: shrinking a model's numbers to lower precision so it runs faster and smaller
example: After quantization the model fits on the watch and only got slightly dumber.

hindi: तिमाही नियोजन — हर तिमाही का प्राथमिकता-निर्धारण अनुष्ठान
definition: the ritual of choosing next quarter's priorities while finishing last quarter's
example: Quarterly planning ate three weeks of the quarter it planned.

hindi: मौन अवधि — IPO के आसपास कंपनी के प्रचार पर नियामक रोक
definition: the regulated window around an offering when a company must avoid promotional statements about itself
example: During the quiet period the founder's podcast went mysteriously on hiatus.

hindi: बिना इस्तीफे बस उतना ही काम जितने के पैसे मिलते हैं
definition: doing exactly your job description and nothing more, without resigning
example: HR called it quiet quitting; he called it working the hours he's paid.

hindi: लक्ष्य राहत — किसी कारणवश विक्रेता के कोटे में कटौती
definition: reduction of a seller's quota to account for leave, territory changes or lost accounts
example: She asked for quota relief after her biggest account was reassigned, and received a motivational speech instead.

hindi: कोटा-धारी — जिस पर सीधा बिक्री लक्ष्य हो
definition: describes a sales role personally assigned a revenue target, with commission depending on hitting it
example: We have forty quota-carrying reps and sixty people who schedule meetings about them.

hindi: गुस्से में आवेदन — दफ़्तर से नाराज़ होकर थोक में दूसरी नौकरियों के लिए अर्ज़ी भेजना
definition: angrily sending dozens of quick applications to other employers after a frustrating workday, quitting the current job in spirit
example: After the third reorg email, Priya spent her lunch break rage applying to eleven companies and one bakery.

hindi: गुस्से के क्लिक — खीझ में एक ही जगह बार-बार क्लिक
definition: rapid repeated clicking on the same element by a frustrated user, tracked as a signal of broken design
example: Session replays showed rage clicks on the 'Save' button, which saves, but silently.

hindi: रैंक करो और निकालो — सबसे निचले कर्मचारियों को हर साल हटाना
definition: forced ranking of employees against each other, with the lowest-ranked slice fired every review cycle
example: Under rank and yank, the team's best strategy was quietly hiring someone to be the bottom ten percent.

hindi: दर सूची — हर पद के प्रति घंटे या प्रति दिन शुल्क की तालिका
definition: table of hourly or daily billing prices for each consultant level, negotiated with the client
example: According to the rate card, the analyst's spreadsheet cost more than his car.

hindi: पुनर्मूल्यांकन — बाज़ार का किसी कंपनी को नया, ऊँचा या नीचा गुणक देना
definition: when markets change the valuation multiple they assign a company, upward or downward
example: Leadership hoped the AI announcement would trigger a re-rating; it triggered follow-up questions.

hindi: अनुमान दोहराना — पिछला पूर्वानुमान बरक़रार रखना
definition: management confirming its previously issued revenue and earnings forecast remains unchanged, signalling nothing has broken
example: We reaffirm guidance, said the CFO, with the enthusiasm of a hostage video.

hindi: वसूली दर — दर्ज घंटों के मूल्य में से वास्तव में वसूला गया हिस्सा
definition: percentage of recorded billable hours value that the client actually ends up paying for
example: The work was brilliant; the realization rate suggested the client disagreed.

hindi: तर्कशील मॉडल — जवाब से पहले चरण-दर-चरण सोचने वाला मॉडल
definition: a model that works through problems step by step before answering, trading speed for accuracy
example: The reasoning model took eleven seconds to conclude you should drink water.

hindi: छूट की दीवार — बड़ी छूट के दम पर पुरानी दवा का नई को सूची से बाहर रखना
definition: an incumbent drug's large volume rebates that make payers reluctant to cover a cheaper or better competitor
example: Our drug is cheaper and better, which the rebate wall considers two irrelevant facts.

hindi: लाल सागर — भीड़ भरा बाज़ार जहाँ प्रतिस्पर्धी कीमत पर लड़ते हैं
definition: a crowded existing market where competitors fight over the same customers, mostly through price cuts and shrinking margins
example: Our blue ocean strategy lasted until three competitors turned it into a red ocean by Tuesday.

hindi: उम्मीदवार के पुराने सहकर्मियों से पूछताछ
definition: calls to a candidate's former colleagues to verify how they actually work
example: The reference check was glowing, as references chosen by the candidate tend to be.

hindi: पुनः पूर्वानुमान — साल के बीच में अनुमानित आँकड़े फिर से तय करना
definition: to revise the annual financial forecast midway through the year using actual year-to-date results
example: We reforecast in July, which is how the target quietly became achievable.

hindi: पुराने अनुदान के ऊपर नया इक्विटी अनुदान
definition: an additional equity grant layered on as earlier grants finish vesting
example: No refresh this cycle means the recruiter messages suddenly look interesting.

hindi: नवीनीकरण अनुदान — प्रारंभिक हिस्सेदारी निहित होने पर मिला नया अनुदान
definition: a fresh equity award given to existing employees, usually as initial grants finish vesting, to keep them staying
example: The refresh grant arrived the week after her recruiter call, which HR insisted was coincidence.

hindi: राहत की तेज़ी — बुरी ख़बर के बाद अस्थायी रिकवरी
definition: a temporary price recovery after heavy selling, when feared news turns out less severe
example: Shares got a relief rally when the layoffs were only ten percent instead of the rumored twenty.

hindi: रिमोट-अनुकूल — दूरस्थ काम की अनुमति, पर संस्कृति दफ़्तर-केंद्रित
definition: describing a company that permits remote work while its culture, decisions and promotions still centre on the office
example: The job ad said remote-friendly, which turned out to mean remote-tolerated.

hindi: पुनः खुलने की दर — बंद टिकटों का वह हिस्सा जो फिर से खुल गया
definition: percentage of closed support tickets reopened because the customer's problem remained unresolved after the agent closed them
example: Our reopen rate dropped to zero once reopening tickets required a support ticket.

hindi: अधीनस्थ कर्मचारी — जो किसी प्रबंधक को रिपोर्ट करता है
definition: an Indian English term for an employee who reports to a particular manager, meaning a direct report
example: He has twelve reportees and still books his own conference rooms.

hindi: भर्ती बोझ — एक रिक्रूटर पर एक साथ चल रहे पदों की संख्या
definition: the number of open requisitions assigned to one recruiter at the same time, used to measure recruiting capacity
example: With a req load of forty, the recruiter's candidate experience was mostly autoresponders.

hindi: वापसी उत्पादन — विदेश गया उत्पादन अपने देश वापस लाना
definition: bringing manufacturing or sourcing back to the home country after previously moving it overseas
example: The reshoring announcement came with a flag, a ribbon cutting and a forty percent price increase.

hindi: ऊपरी रूप बदलना — ढाँचा वही, सिर्फ़ रंग-रूप नया
definition: to change a product's visual styling such as colours, fonts and icons without altering its structure or flows
example: We reskinned the app for the rebrand, and every confusing flow now confuses people in teal.

hindi: पुनर्कथन — पहले प्रकाशित वित्तीय नतीजों को ग़लती मिलने पर दोबारा जारी करना
definition: the reissuing of previously published financial statements after errors are discovered, often triggering investigations
example: After the restatement, last year's record growth became last year's respectable growth.

hindi: पुनर्गठन — ढांचा बदलने की आड़ में अक्सर पद-कटौती
definition: reorganizing the business in ways that usually include eliminating roles
example: Restructuring was announced; everyone refreshed the org chart and their resumes.

hindi: रोककर रखने वाला अनुदान — किसी को जाने से रोकने हेतु दिया गया अतिरिक्त इक्विटी
definition: an extra equity grant offered to keep a valued employee from leaving, typically vesting over a fresh multi-year schedule
example: Nothing makes a manager discover your value like a competing offer and a retention grant form.

hindi: बायोडाटा बनवाने वाली घटना — ऐसी भूल जिसके बाद नई नौकरी ढूँढनी पड़े
definition: resume generating event; a mistake serious enough to get someone fired and sent looking for employment elsewhere
example: Dropping the production database on a Friday is a classic RGE.

hindi: अमीर या राजा — पैसा बढ़ाने या नियंत्रण रखने में से एक चुनने की संस्थापक दुविधा
definition: the founder's tradeoff between raising outside capital to build wealth and keeping personal control of the company
example: He said he had weighed rich versus king, then signed the term sheet and spent every board meeting mourning the crown.

hindi: सही लोगों को बस में बिठाना — रणनीति से पहले सही टीम चुनना
definition: principle that leaders should first hire the right people and remove the wrong ones before deciding strategy or direction
example: We got the right people on the bus, then the reorg changed the route and the driver.

hindi: लेखा परीक्षा अधिकार — ग्राहक द्वारा वेंडर के रिकॉर्ड व नियंत्रण जाँचने की अनुमति
definition: a contract clause letting a customer inspect a vendor's records, security controls or billing to verify compliance
example: Their right to audit meant three consultants, two weeks and one very tidy server room.

hindi: संपर्क-विच्छेद का अधिकार — काम के घंटों के बाद ईमेल और कॉल अनदेखा करने का अधिकार
definition: employee's legal or policy right to ignore work emails, messages and calls outside working hours
example: Our policy guarantees the right to disconnect, announced in a message sent at eleven at night.

hindi: छँटनी का सौम्य नाम — कर्मचारियों की संख्या घटाना
definition: reducing staff numbers, phrased to sound like optimization rather than layoffs
example: The all-hands announced rightsizing; twelve desks were empty by Friday.

hindi: मानवीय प्रतिक्रिया से पुनर्बलन — लोगों की पसंद से मॉडल को सुधारना
definition: reinforcement learning from human feedback; training a model on people's preference ratings
example: RLHF is why the coach says 'great effort' instead of the truth.

hindi: सतत यात्री — काम के लिए हर हफ़्ते सफ़र करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: employee, typically a consultant, who travels to client locations every week and lives out of hotels
example: The road warrior knew every airport lounge password and none of his neighbours.

hindi: निवेशक दौरा — IPO से पहले शेयर बेचने के लिए प्रस्तुतियों की यात्रा
definition: the series of investor presentations management gives across cities before pricing a share listing or bond offering
example: By the fourth roadshow city the CEO could deliver the growth story in his sleep, and occasionally did.

hindi: आगे बढ़ाया मिलान — आरंभिक शेष से अंतिम शेष तक हर बदलाव का विवरण
definition: schedule reconciling an account's opening balance to its closing balance by listing every addition and reduction
example: The fixed-asset roll forward didn't foot, so the missing laptop became a finance-wide mystery.

hindi: क्रमिक विस्तार — फ़ीचर को चरणों में जारी करना
definition: releasing something gradually to users, in stages you can retreat from
example: The rollout is at five percent, where it's been resting comfortably.

hindi: सूचीकरण पंजीकरण दस्तावेज़ — अमेरिकी शेयर बाज़ार में उतरने से पहले दाखिल विस्तृत विवरण
definition: the American registration filing a company publishes before listing, disclosing financials, risks and ownership
example: Everyone read the S-1 for the risk factors and the exact compensation of the founders.

hindi: बिक्री अभियंता — तकनीकी सवालों के जवाब देने वाला विशेषज्ञ
definition: the technical expert who joins sales calls to answer the hard questions
example: The sales engineer's job: make the demo survive contact with a real question.

hindi: बिक्री गति — पाइपलाइन से राजस्व बनने की रफ़्तार
definition: rate revenue moves through pipeline, combining opportunity count, deal size, conversion rate and cycle length
example: To boost sales velocity, leadership shortened the sales cycle by redefining when it starts.

hindi: बिक्री-आधारित विकास — सेल्स टीम के ज़रिए ग्राहक जोड़ने वाली रणनीति
definition: growth strategy where sales representatives drive customer acquisition through demos, negotiations and contracts rather than self-serve product usage
example: We're sales-led growth with a free trial nobody is allowed to find.

hindi: प्रतिबंध जाँच — ग्राहक या भुगतान को प्रतिबंधित सूचियों से मिलाना
definition: checking customers, partners and transactions against government sanctions lists before doing business with them
example: Sanctions screening flagged a customer called Crimea Pizza, and the deal desk had a long afternoon.

hindi: मूल्य-श्रृंखला उत्सर्जन — आपूर्तिकर्ताओं और ग्राहकों तक फैला अप्रत्यक्ष उत्सर्जन
definition: indirect greenhouse emissions across the value chain, from suppliers, business travel, product usage and disposal
example: Scope 3 emissions are ninety percent of our footprint and one hundred percent of nobody's objectives.

hindi: मूल्यांकन पत्रक — साक्षात्कार के बाद भरा जाने वाला अंक-पत्र
definition: the written interview feedback form rating a candidate against defined competencies with a recommendation
example: Please submit your scorecard before the debrief, not during it.

hindi: जुगाड़ू — कम पैसे और साधनों में तेज़ी से काम निकाल लेने वाला
definition: resourceful and fast-moving with very little money, staff or tooling, typical of early startup teams
example: We were scrappy enough to build the demo on a free tier and nervous enough to never click the billing tab.

hindi: स्क्रम मास्टर — प्रक्रिया चलाने और बाधा हटाने वाला सूत्रधार
definition: the facilitator who runs scrum's ceremonies and clears the team's blockers
example: Our scrum master's whole job is defending the team's calendar.

hindi: उड़ता-आता मैनेजर — अचानक आकर शोर मचाए, गड़बड़ करे और गायब हो जाए
definition: a manager who appears only when problems surface, makes noisy criticism and sweeping changes, then disappears
example: Our seagull manager flew in, rewrote the roadmap, and was back on leave by lunch.

hindi: मौजूदा शेयरों की बिक्री — एक्ज़िट से पहले पुराने हिस्सेदारों की कमाई
definition: a sale of existing shares, letting early holders cash out before an exit
example: The founders took a small secondary and suddenly believed in work-life balance.

hindi: चुनिंदा प्रकटीकरण — अहम जानकारी केवल कुछ निवेशकों को देना
definition: sharing material company information with certain investors or analysts before releasing it publicly to everyone, which regulators prohibit
example: Compliance treats any dinner with a fund manager as a selective disclosure risk with appetizers.

hindi: स्वयं-सेवा रिपोर्टिंग — बिना विश्लेषक के ख़ुद डेटा खोजने और रिपोर्ट बनाने के औज़ार
definition: reporting tools that let business users explore company data and build their own dashboards without waiting for an analyst
example: Self-service BI launched Monday; by Tuesday the analysts were servicing everyone's self-service.

hindi: मनाने वाली कॉल — उम्मीदवार को प्रस्ताव स्वीकारने के लिए राज़ी करने की बातचीत
definition: a call where leaders pitch the company to persuade a candidate to accept an offer
example: The CEO's sell call mentioned the mission eleven times and the equity once.

hindi: संवेदनशीलता विश्लेषण — एक अनुमान बदलने पर नतीजा कितना बदलता है
definition: testing how much a model's outcome changes when individual assumptions such as price, volume or cost are varied
example: The sensitivity analysis showed the whole business case depended on one assumption labelled 'TBC'.

hindi: काला पानी भेजना — किसी को महत्वहीन और दूर-दराज़ के काम में धकेल देना
definition: sidelined into an unimportant, low-visibility role or location as punishment after falling out with leadership
example: After contradicting the CEO, she was sent to Siberia to lead the intranet refresh.

hindi: सर्वर से मापन — ब्राउज़र की जगह कंपनी के अपने सर्वर से बिक्री का आँकड़ा भेजना
definition: sending conversion events from your own servers rather than browsers, avoiding blockers and cookie restrictions
example: Server-side tracking recovered thirty percent of our conversions, and one hundred percent of engineering's patience.

hindi: छाया संगठन-चार्ट — असली प्रभाव और रिश्तों का अनलिखा नक़्शा
definition: the unofficial network showing who actually holds influence and decides things, regardless of formal titles and reporting lines
example: On paper she's a senior analyst; on the shadow org chart she runs the division.

hindi: तीखी कोहनियाँ — आगे बढ़ने के लिए दूसरों को धकेलने वाला आक्रामक रवैया
definition: an aggressive, competitive working style that pushes colleagues aside to capture credit, resources or promotion
example: She has sharp elbows, but at least you always know which meeting she'll win.

hindi: शेल्फ़ पर पड़ा सॉफ़्टवेयर — ख़रीदा गया लेकिन कभी इस्तेमाल न हुआ लाइसेंस
definition: software licences an organisation purchased and keeps paying for, but which nobody actually uses
example: We bought five hundred seats; forty log in, and the rest is shelfware with a renewal date.

hindi: पाली भत्ता — रात या विदेशी समय-क्षेत्र में काम करने का अतिरिक्त पैसा
definition: extra payment for working night shifts or client timezone hours, common in support and offshore delivery teams
example: The shift allowance covers exactly one strong coffee per night of the US shift.

hindi: पहले की ओर खिसकाना — परीक्षण और सुरक्षा जाँच को विकास में पहले ही शुरू करना
definition: moving testing, security and quality checks earlier in the development process instead of leaving them until release
example: Management wants to shift left, which apparently means testing now starts in the kickoff meeting.

hindi: खर्च दिखावा — विभाग को उसकी लागत दिखाना पर शुल्क न लेना
definition: reporting the internal costs a department consumes without actually billing its budget, unlike a chargeback
example: Showback changed nothing until finance hinted it would become a chargeback next year.

hindi: अलग पत्र — किसी एक निवेशक को दिए गए अतिरिक्त अधिकार
definition: a separate agreement granting one investor extra rights or terms outside the main financing documents
example: The cap table looked clean until someone found the side letter promising a board seat to three different people.

hindi: एक ही स्रोत चुनना — विकल्प होते हुए भी जानबूझकर एक विक्रेता से ख़रीद
definition: deliberately buying from one chosen supplier without competitive bidding even though other suppliers could provide it
example: We single source it because switching would mean learning a new invoice format.

hindi: छह-पन्नों का ज्ञापन — मीटिंग से पहले पढ़ा जाने वाला लिखित प्रस्ताव
definition: a narrative memo of at most six pages that attendees read silently at the start of a meeting instead of watching slides
example: He wrote a six-pager, then asked if he could also present the deck.

hindi: समाधान बिक्री — उत्पाद नहीं, ग्राहक की समस्या का हल बेचना
definition: selling approach centred on diagnosing customer problems first and positioning the product as their remedy
example: It's solution selling, so we diagnose their problem, which happily always turns out to be our product.

hindi: भावी यूनिकॉर्न — जल्द एक अरब डॉलर मूल्यांकन छूने की उम्मीद वाला स्टार्टअप
definition: a startup expected to reach a billion-dollar valuation soon, a label especially common in Indian English startup press
example: Three funding announcements called us a soonicorn, and none of them mentioned our burn.

hindi: पहुँच, जान-पहचान — भारतीय अंग्रेज़ी में नौकरी या काम निकलवाने का निजी संपर्क
definition: in Indian English, a personal connection with influence, used to secure a hire, approval or favour
example: He didn't clear the interview loop; he came in through source.

hindi: जगह का उपयोग — दफ़्तर की जगह कितनी और कैसे काम आ रही है
definition: measuring how much office desk and room space is actually used over time, usually to justify shrinking it
example: Space utilisation data showed the boardroom is used twice a month, both times for crying.

hindi: उलझा हुआ कोड — नूडल्स-सा गुत्थमगुत्था, समझ से परे प्रवाह
definition: tangled code whose control flow twists like noodles, defying comprehension
example: I traced the spaghetti code for an hour and ended where I started.

hindi: वक्ता कार्यक्रम — कंपनी द्वारा डॉक्टर को भुगतान देकर साथियों को दवा पर बोलवाना
definition: a company-sponsored event where paid physicians present approved drug information to fellow prescribers, heavily scrutinized by compliance
example: Compliance reviewed the speaker program menu longer than the slides.

hindi: विशेष परियोजनाएँ — किसी को हटाने से पहले दिया जाने वाला अस्पष्ट पद
definition: a euphemism for a vague role given to a sidelined executive, often shortly before they leave
example: He's moving to special projects, which is HR for 'update your LinkedIn'.

hindi: तात्कालिक बिक्री बोनस — ख़ास उत्पाद बेचने पर इनाम
definition: a short-term bonus for selling a specific product or hitting a sprint goal
example: A $500 spiff on the new module and suddenly every demo features it.

hindi: प्रश्न-आधारित बिक्री — स्थिति, समस्या, प्रभाव और ज़रूरत वाले प्रश्नों से बेचना
definition: consultative questioning method moving through situation, problem, implication and need-payoff questions before pitching
example: His SPIN selling was flawless, except he asked all four questions before the customer had finished sitting down.

hindi: बंद कमरों में आपकी पैरवी करने वाला वरिष्ठ
definition: a senior person who advocates for your promotion in rooms you're not in
example: A mentor gives advice; a sponsor says your name in calibration.

hindi: ऊपर से एआई छिड़क दो — बिना सोचे उत्पाद में एआई जोड़ने का आदेश
definition: an instruction to bolt artificial intelligence features onto an existing product mainly so it sounds modern and fundable
example: The roadmap review ended, as always, with someone asking us to sprinkle some AI on it.

hindi: स्प्रिंट — विकास कार्य का छोटा निश्चित चक्र, प्रायः दो सप्ताह
definition: a short fixed period, usually two weeks, in which a team commits to specific work
example: We'll pick that up next sprint, which is agile for eventually.

hindi: क्रमिक बोर्ड — हर साल केवल कुछ निदेशकों का चुनाव, ताकि बोर्ड एक झटके में न बदले
definition: a board where directors serve overlapping multi-year terms, so only a fraction face election each year, slowing takeovers
example: Thanks to the staggered board, the activist needed three annual meetings and considerable patience to win control.

hindi: हितधारक नक़्शा — कौन कितना प्रभावशाली है और किस पक्ष में है, इसका चार्ट
definition: a chart plotting stakeholders by their influence and attitude toward a project, used to plan persuasion and approvals
example: According to the stakeholder map, the real decision maker is the finance lead nobody invited.

hindi: छिपी छँटनी — बिना घोषणा के लोगों को धीरे-धीरे हटाना
definition: cutting staff without announcing layoffs, through harsh ratings, relocation demands or office mandates
example: The return-to-office mandate was a stealth layoff with a free-lunch coupon attached.

hindi: अल्पकालिक प्रोत्साहन — एक वर्ष के प्रदर्शन पर मिलने वाला बोनस
definition: short-term incentive; the annual cash bonus paid against yearly company and individual performance targets
example: The STI formula has four weighted factors, and all of them are somehow the CFO's mood.

hindi: माल ख़त्म — माँग होने पर भी भंडार में वस्तु न होना
definition: running completely out of inventory for an item while customers are still ordering it, losing sales
example: Our bestseller hit a stockout the same morning the ad campaign went live.

hindi: रणनीतिक ग्राहक खाता — अत्यधिक राजस्व या महत्व वाला विशेष ग्राहक
definition: high-value customer account receiving dedicated attention because of large revenue, growth potential or reputational importance
example: Every account becomes a strategic account the week before it threatens to leave.

hindi: रणनीतिक विकल्प — कंपनी या उसका हिस्सा बेचने की खोज का शिष्ट नाम
definition: euphemism announcing a company is considering selling itself, merging, or divesting a division
example: The board is exploring strategic alternatives, so the team started exploring LinkedIn.

hindi: क्षमता से बड़ा काम — तरक्की का (और थकान का) मौका
definition: a task above your current level, offered as growth, unpaid at the new level
example: The stretch assignment was staff-level work at senior-level pay.

hindi: उप-प्रसंस्कर्ता — वेंडर का वह वेंडर जो ग्राहक का डेटा छूता है
definition: a third-party vendor that your vendor uses to process customer personal data, usually listed publicly and requiring notice before changes
example: Adding one analytics library meant emailing every customer about a new subprocessor.

hindi: सफलता योजना — ग्राहक के लक्ष्यों और उन्हें पाने के कदमों का लिखित दस्तावेज़
definition: shared document between customer success manager and customer listing the customer's business goals, milestones and responsibilities for achieving them
example: The success plan was signed off enthusiastically and opened again at renewal.

hindi: ऊँची दायित्व सीमा — डेटा उल्लंघन जैसे जोखिमों के लिए अलग, बड़ी हद
definition: a separate, higher liability cap carved out for specific risks such as data breaches, confidentiality or indemnity claims
example: The compromise was a super cap for data breaches, which both sides privately hoped never to test.

hindi: उत्तरजीवी पूर्वाग्रह — सिर्फ बचे हुओं को देखकर निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: drawing conclusions only from what survived while ignoring what vanished
example: Retention looks great among users who stayed, notes the survivorship bias.

hindi: तालमेल — मिलकर काम करने से बढ़ा हुआ असर
definition: combined effect greater than the sum of parts; the go-to justification for any merger or reorg
example: The acquisition deck promised synergies nobody has located since.

hindi: कृत्रिम डेटा — असली डेटा की कमी में मशीन से बनाया प्रशिक्षण डेटा
definition: artificially generated data used for training when real data is scarce or sensitive
example: We generated synthetic data for rare injuries rather than waiting for real ones.

hindi: सिस्टम प्रॉम्प्ट — एआई का व्यवहार तय करने वाले छिपे स्थायी निर्देश
definition: hidden standing instructions that set an AI product's behavior before users type anything
example: Someone edited the system prompt, and the coach turned aggressively cheerful overnight.

hindi: साथ बेचने का अधिकार — बड़े शेयरधारक बेचें तो छोटे भी उसी शर्त पर बेच सकें
definition: a term sheet clause letting minority shareholders join a sale when major shareholders sell their shares, on the same terms
example: Thanks to the tag-along, the early employees got to ride the founder's exit instead of watching it from the platform.

hindi: छोर का जोखिम — बहुत कम संभावना वाला पर भारी नुकसान वाला खतरा
definition: the small chance of a rare, extreme event causing outsized losses beyond normal expectations
example: The tail risk of one engineer owning the billing system is small until that engineer takes leave.

hindi: पीछे-पीछे घुसना — किसी और के बैज से बिना जाँच दफ़्तर में प्रवेश
definition: following someone through a badge-controlled office door without swiping your own access card
example: Security posters warn against tailgating, yet nobody wants to be the person who shuts the door on a colleague holding coffee.

hindi: अनुकूल हवाएँ — कारोबार को आगे बढ़ाने वाली बाहरी परिस्थितियाँ
definition: external business conditions boosting revenue growth or margins, independent of management decisions and product performance
example: The tailwinds did the heavy lifting; the press release thanked the leadership team.

hindi: पेशकश वापस लेने की चाल — छूट या विकल्प हटाकर ख़रीदने की इच्छा जगाना
definition: a closing technique where the seller withdraws a discount or option so the buyer wants it more
example: His takeaway close removed the discount, and the prospect removed themselves from the thread.

hindi: प्रतिभा भंडार — भविष्य की भर्ती के लिए सहेजे उम्मीदवार
definition: the saved group of qualified candidates a company keeps warm for future openings
example: He has been in our talent pool for two years and has never once been told about an opening.

hindi: अपने सौदे की वकालत — अपनी निवेश स्थिति के हित में राय देना
definition: publicly promoting investments or positions you already hold, so the opinion quietly serves your personal financial interest
example: Of course the VC says the sector is undervalued; he's talking his book.

hindi: लक्षित संचालन मॉडल — भविष्य में संगठन कैसे काम करेगा, इसका खाका
definition: the designed future state of how an organisation will operate, covering structure, processes, technology, roles and governance
example: The target operating model had clean boxes and arrows, and none of them was the current team.

hindi: संक्षिप्त परिचय पत्र — बिक्री हेतु कंपनी का गुमनाम एक-पन्ने का विवरण
definition: a short anonymous summary sent to potential buyers to gauge interest before sharing confidential details
example: The teaser called the target 'a leading regional player', which narrowed it to one company.

hindi: तकनीकी रडार — कंपनी में किन तकनीकों को अपनाना, आज़माना या छोड़ना है, इसकी सूची
definition: a published guide rating which technologies a company should adopt, trial, assess or phase out
example: The tech radar says 'hold' on the framework our entire product is built on.

hindi: तकनीकी मंज़ूरी — ग्राहक की तकनीकी टीम द्वारा उत्पाद को उपयुक्त घोषित करना
definition: the milestone in an enterprise sale when the buyer's technical evaluators confirm the product meets their requirements, leaving only commercial negotiation
example: We secured the technical win in March and have been losing the commercial one ever since.

hindi: वह स्तर जिसके आगे पदोन्नति अनिवार्य नहीं
definition: the level where you may stay indefinitely without being pushed to advance
example: Senior is the terminal level; past that, promotion is optional ambition.

hindi: तृतीय-स्तर सहायता — इंजीनियरों तक पहुँची अंतिम सहायता
definition: final support layer, usually engineers or product specialists, handling escalated customer problems that need code changes or deep system access
example: By the time it reached tier 3 support, the customer had written their own root cause analysis.

hindi: समय-पत्रक चूककर्ता — समय पर काम के घंटे दर्ज न करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: in Indian English, an employee who missed filling weekly hours in the timesheet system, publicly listed in reminder emails
example: Being named a timesheet defaulter is the fastest way to make the all-hands mailing list.

hindi: सिर्फ़ देखने वाला — जो दिलचस्पी दिखाए पर ख़रीदने का इरादा न रखे
definition: a prospect who requests demos, pricing and trials with no real budget or intention of purchasing
example: He booked six demos, downloaded every white paper, and turned out to be a tire kicker writing a blog post.

hindi: यांत्रिक मशक्कत — बार-बार का हाथ से होने वाला थकाऊ परिचालन काम
definition: repetitive manual operational work that automation should have eaten by now
example: Two hours of daily toil; automating it stays on the someday list.

hindi: खपत की सीमा — किसी सुविधा पर मॉडल के इस्तेमाल की तय हद
definition: a spending limit on how many model tokens a team, feature or request may consume
example: Finance approved the feature on the condition that its token budget fit on a napkin.

hindi: शीर्ष का रवैया — नेतृत्व का आचरण जो पूरी कंपनी की नैतिक संस्कृति तय करता है
definition: the ethical climate that senior leadership sets through its own behaviour, shaping how seriously employees treat integrity and controls
example: The ethics training stressed tone at the top, shortly before the CEO expensed his birthday party.

hindi: लहजा — स्थिति के अनुसार ब्रांड-लेखन का भाव
definition: guidelines describing how a brand's writing should sound and how that tone shifts between contexts, such as apologies, launches or error messages
example: The tone of voice guide says 'warm and human', so the outage notice opened with a pun.

hindi: ऊपर से तय बजट — नेतृत्व द्वारा लक्ष्य तय कर नीचे बाँटा गया बजट
definition: a budget where leadership sets the total target first and then divides it among departments
example: The top-down budget arrived as one number and a memo saying teams should find efficiencies.

hindi: कुल पारिश्रमिक — वेतन, बोनस और शेयर मिलाकर
definition: salary, bonus, and equity added together, the number that actually matters
example: Base looked modest until total comp included the equity refresh.

hindi: यात्रा सहायता विभाग — कर्मचारियों के टिकट और होटल बुक करने वाली आंतरिक टीम
definition: the internal company team or service that books flights, hotels and cabs for employees travelling on business
example: The travel desk booked me into the right hotel in the wrong city with the same name.

hindi: छाँटना — गंभीरता के आधार पर प्राथमिकता तय करना
definition: to sort incoming bugs or requests by urgency so the worst gets attention first
example: We triage bugs on Mondays; by Wednesday they've healed or multiplied.

hindi: ऋण गुणक — कर्ज़ EBITDA का कितने गुना है
definition: debt expressed as a multiple of EBITDA, the standard measure of how indebted a deal is
example: Six turns of leverage looked fine on the model and terrifying in the credit committee.

hindi: दोतरफ़ा दरवाज़ा — ऐसा फ़ैसला जिसे आसानी से पलटा जा सके, इसलिए जल्दी लिया जाए
definition: decision that is cheap and easy to reverse, which should be made quickly by small groups without heavy review
example: It's a two-way door, she said, closing the meeting before anyone could walk through it.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता-निर्मित सामग्री — ग्राहकों द्वारा बनाई गई ब्रांड-सामग्री
definition: user-generated content; photos, videos, reviews and posts created by customers rather than the brand, often reused in marketing with permission
example: The UGC campaign invited photos of happy customers and mostly received photos of broken parcels.

hindi: अल्प-अनुकूलन — इतना सरल मॉडल कि पैटर्न ही न पकड़ पाए
definition: a model too simple to capture the pattern, wrong on old and new data alike
example: It calls every exercise 'movement detected' — underfitting with confidence.

hindi: कम स्तर पर रखा गया — क्षमता से नीचे के स्तर पर नियुक्त
definition: hired or placed at a career level below what their skills and responsibilities warrant
example: She was underleveled at hiring and spent two years doing senior work at junior salary.

hindi: असीमित छुट्टी की नीति — जो अक्सर कम छुट्टी में बदलती है
definition: no fixed vacation allowance, which quietly means no payout and peer-pressured minimums
example: Unlimited PTO, and somehow everyone takes less than the old fifteen days.

hindi: अनियुक्त — जिसे अभी किसी ग्राहक परियोजना पर नहीं लगाया गया
definition: describes a consultant not currently assigned to any client project, awaiting the next staffing decision
example: Being unstaffed in December felt restful until someone mentioned utilization.

hindi: अद्यतन करना — किसी रिकॉर्ड या जानकारी को नया करने की प्रक्रिया
definition: an Indian English noun for the act of updating records, documents, sheets or system data
example: The tracker needs updation, a task that has itself been on the tracker since June.

hindi: शुरुआती सहमति — बैठक से पहले समय, उद्देश्य और संभावित परिणाम तय कर लेना
definition: a sales technique of agreeing at the start of a meeting on time, purpose, agenda and acceptable outcomes, including an explicit rejection
example: The upfront contract allowed a clear no, which the prospect exercised in minute four.

hindi: खर्च करो वरना गँवाओ — बचा बजट साल के अंत में वापस चला जाना
definition: the rule that unspent budget disappears at year-end, which pushes teams to spend whatever remains before the deadline
example: Use it or lose it explains why the team bought six standing desks in the last week of March.

hindi: उपयोग दर — कुल समय में ग्राहक-शुल्क वाले काम का प्रतिशत
definition: share of a consultant's working hours charged to client projects, tracked weekly as a performance measure
example: Her utilization rate hit 110 percent, which says more about the timesheet than the week.

hindi: दाँव पर मूल्य — किसी फ़ैसले से जुड़ा संभावित लाभ या नुकसान
definition: the estimated revenue, profit or cost savings that depend on a decision or initiative, used to rank priorities
example: The value at stake justified the project, and the project fees quietly reduced the value at stake.

hindi: परिवर्तनीय वेतन — प्रदर्शन पर निर्भर तनख्वाह का हिस्सा
definition: the portion of compensation tied to individual or company performance, paid as bonus rather than fixed salary
example: Variable pay turned out to be very variable, mostly in the downward direction.

hindi: सदिश डेटाबेस — अर्थ की समानता से खोज करने वाला भंडार
definition: a database that stores embeddings and finds items by similarity of meaning
example: Every FAQ lives in the vector database; the bot finds answers by vibes, mathematically.

hindi: विक्रेता कोड — कंपनी की प्रणाली में आपूर्तिकर्ता की पहचान संख्या, बिना इसके भुगतान नहीं
definition: the supplier identifier created in the finance system after registration, without which no purchase order or payment can be raised
example: The workshop is tomorrow, but the facilitator's vendor code is 'in process' until next quarter.

hindi: वेंचर-पोषित — VC पूँजी से चलने वाली, ऊँची उम्मीदों समेत
definition: funded by venture capital, with the growth expectations that come attached
example: Venture-backed means the growth targets arrive before the revenue does.

hindi: प्रसार गुणांक — हर उपयोगकर्ता औसतन कितने नए उपयोगकर्ता जोड़ता है
definition: average number of new users each existing user successfully brings in; above one means self-sustaining growth
example: Our viral coefficient crossed one for a single afternoon, when an intern invited his entire contact list.

hindi: लहजा और स्वर — ब्रांड कैसे बोलता है इसके नियम
definition: guidelines describing how a product's written language should sound, and how that shifts by situation
example: Voice and tone said 'friendly but professional', so the error messages now apologise with exclamation marks.

hindi: पीछे हटने की सीमा — वह शर्त जिसके बाद सौदा छोड़ देना तय है
definition: the worst price or terms a negotiator will accept before abandoning the negotiation entirely
example: Our walk-away point was firm until the quarter had four days left.

hindi: परिचित के ज़रिए परिचय — भरोसे के साथ संपर्क
definition: an introduction to a prospect made by someone they already know and trust
example: One warm intro from an investor beat two hundred cold emails.

hindi: संकटकालीन मुख्य कार्यकारी — संकट में तेज़, कठोर फ़ैसले लेने वाला प्रमुख
definition: a chief executive who leads through existential crisis with rapid, decisive and often unpopular decisions
example: He declared himself a wartime CEO, which mostly meant cancelling the offsite.

hindi: देखने का कुल समय — दर्शकों द्वारा वीडियो पर बिताए मिनट
definition: total minutes audiences spend viewing a creator's videos, a signal platforms weigh heavily when recommending content
example: To boost watch time, the three-minute tutorial now has a nine-minute intro.

hindi: गपशप चैनल — काम से अलग अनौपचारिक बातचीत के लिए टीम चैट चैनल
definition: team chat channel reserved for informal social conversation, pets and weekend photos rather than work
example: The watercooler channel has more engagement than every project channel combined, mostly because of one cat.

hindi: दिखावटी कल्याण — असली समस्याएँ सुलझाए बिना कर्मचारी कल्याण का प्रचार
definition: promoting employee wellbeing through apps, yoga and slogans while ignoring workloads, staffing and pay that cause burnout
example: The meditation app launch was pure wellness washing; the headcount freeze stayed firmly in place.

hindi: कहाँ खेलें — किन बाज़ारों, ग्राहकों और चैनलों को चुनें
definition: the strategic choice of which markets, customer segments, geographies and channels a company will compete in and which it will avoid
example: Asked where to play, the leadership team chose every market, segment and channel at once.

hindi: दोनों ओर से मार — भाव के अचानक उलट-पलट से नुकसान झेलना
definition: to jerk people, plans or prices back and forth through sudden reversals of direction, causing losses each time
example: The roadmap was whipsawed by three strategy changes in one quarter, and so were the engineers.

hindi: रक्षक खरीदार — शत्रुतापूर्ण बोली से बचाने आया मित्र अधिग्रहणकर्ता
definition: a friendly acquirer invited by management to outbid a hostile bidder for the company
example: The white knight rode in with a lower price but a promise to keep the chairman.

hindi: अभी क्यों — पिच में यह बताना कि यह विचार इसी समय क्यों सफल होगा
definition: the pitch-deck question explaining which recent market or technology change makes this startup possible today
example: The why now slide said 'AI', which covered this year and apparently every year before it.

hindi: जीत-हार विश्लेषण — सौदे क्यों जीते या हारे, इसकी पड़ताल
definition: structured study interviewing buyers about why deals succeeded or failed, to improve sales strategy
example: The win-loss analysis found we lose on price, win on price, and occasionally lose because nobody called back.

hindi: पहले से तय सौदा — जिसमें विजेता विक्रेता पहले से चुना जा चुका हो
definition: a purchase whose winning vendor is chosen before the formal evaluation starts, often with requirements written around them
example: The RFP required integration with our competitor's proprietary format, a subtle sign of a wired deal.

hindi: गोदाम प्रबंधन प्रणाली — भंडारण, माल निकालने और भेजने का सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: warehouse management system; software tracking stock locations, receiving, picking, packing and shipping inside a warehouse
example: The WMS knows exactly where every pallet is, in the warehouse we closed last year.

hindi: ठीक नहीं करेंगे — टिकट पर लगी मुहर कि समस्या जानते हुए भी सुधारी नहीं जाएगी
definition: describing a reported defect or request deliberately closed without being repaired, because it is intended, too costly or unimportant
example: Closed as wontfix, which is engineering for 'we have made peace with this'.

hindi: दफ़्तरी पति — दफ़्तर का सबसे करीबी, भरोसेमंद (गैर-रोमांटिक) पुरुष सहकर्मी
definition: a close, trusted, platonic male colleague who shares daily support, gossip and lunch at work
example: Her work husband saves her a seat in every all-hands and a cynical comment for every slide.

hindi: कार्यशील पूंजी — रोज़मर्रा के कामकाज में फंसी नकदी
definition: current assets minus current liabilities; the cash tied up running daily operations through receivables, inventory and payables
example: Sales grew so fast that working capital swallowed every rupee of profit before it reached the bank.

hindi: खुलकर काम करना — अपनी प्रगति और सोच सार्वजनिक चैनलों में साझा करते रहना
definition: sharing progress, drafts and reasoning openly in public channels so remote colleagues can follow the work
example: He was working out loud so thoroughly that the channel became a diary of his lunch choices.

hindi: बिल कटौती — दर्ज किए गए घंटों में से ग्राहक को कम पैसा भेजना
definition: reduction of recorded billable hours before invoicing, because the client will refuse the full amount
example: The partner called it goodwill; finance called it a forty-hour write-down.

hindi: कल का मौसम — पिछले स्प्रिंट जितना ही अगले में होगा, यह मानना
definition: predicting next sprint's output from last sprint's, whatever optimism says
example: Yesterday's weather says twenty points, not the forty in this plan.

term: you build it, you run it
hindi: जो बनाए वही चलाए — अपनी सेवा का संचालन और रात की ज़िम्मेदारी भी स्वयं उठाना
definition: the principle that the engineering team which builds a service also operates it in production and carries its on-call duty
example: You build it, you run it, and at three in the morning you also regret it.

hindi: वर्ष की शुरुआत से अब तक — साल के पहले दिन से आज तक का कुल
definition: year to date; results accumulated from the start of the fiscal year to the current reporting date
example: YTD we are on plan, provided nobody looks at the monthly trend.

hindi: ज़ेब्रा स्टार्टअप — मुनाफ़ा और सामाजिक उद्देश्य दोनों साधने वाली कंपनी
definition: a startup that pursues sustainable profit and social purpose together, rejecting the unicorn chase for blitz growth
example: We pitched ourselves as a zebra startup, and the VC politely asked where the horn was.

hindi: शून्य अवस्था — डेटा आने से पहले की स्क्रीन
definition: the screen users see before any content or data exists, designed to guide their first action
example: The zero state said 'Nothing here yet!' with an illustration, and no hint about what should be there.

hindi: मरी हुई पर चलती बैठक — उद्देश्य खत्म होने के बाद भी दोहराई जाने वाली मीटिंग
definition: a recurring meeting that keeps appearing on calendars long after its original purpose ended
example: The zombie meeting has no agenda and no owner, yet eight people attend faithfully.

hindi: ज़ॉम्बी स्टार्टअप — न बढ़ने वाली, न मरने वाली कंपनी
definition: a company alive enough to keep operating but too stalled to grow or exit
example: It's a zombie startup: payroll clears, and absolutely nothing else happens.
